Title: (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) in Berlin
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Corporate Functions - Performance & Reward ein attraktives, motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld gestalten? Unser Team entwickelt Konzepte und Programme rund um die Themen Karriere, Benefits, Recognition oder (leistungsbezogene) Vergütung. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Standorte: Düsseldorf, Berlin, Dresden, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Leipzig, Magdeburg, Mannheim, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.


Konzeption: Du entwickelst geeignete Algorithmen und Modelle zur Aufbereitung entscheidungsrelevanter Daten und erschaffst individuelle Dashboards anhand moderner Business-Intelligence-Tools.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
Opportunity to work from abroad

Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark
Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.

Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.


Who are Atlas & Nova?

I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.

And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.

Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.

Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.

Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Nova a try. You could land this role. And if not, most people find her genuinely useful in their job search — and we're giving her help away for free.

Title: Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d)
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Strategy, Risk & Transactions – Advisory – Mergers & Acquisitions Kunden entlang des gesamten M&A-Deal-Zyklus begleiten – von Strategie und Due Diligence über Finanzierungs- und Technologiefragen bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Integration von Transaktionen? Unser Team unterstützt Mandanten beim Kauf, Verkauf oder Zusammenschluss von Unternehmen - strategisch, finanziell und rechtlich. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg und München.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Consultant Data Analytics & Business Insights (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten bei komplexen M&A-Transaktionen – und kombinierst dabei Finance-Expertise mit Data Analytics, um nachhaltige Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen.


Data Analytics: Mit Hilfe modernster Analytics-Methoden bereitest du große Datenmengen effizient auf, erkennst Muster und prüfst Hypothesen datenbasiert – unterstützt durch unsere etablierten Best Practices.
Datenmuster: Du identifizierst Datenmuster, um aufgestellte Hypothesen zu prüfen, und verknüpfst entscheidungsrelevante Daten und Informationen.
Visualisierung: Interaktive Dashboards konzipierst du mit Business-Intelligence-Tools, sodass komplexe Finanzinformationen für Stakeholder verständlich dargestellt werden.
Stakeholder-Kommunikation: In deinen Projekten generierst du gemeinsam mit Data-Science-Experten wertschaffende Einblicke und kommunizierst datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen an ausgewählte Stakeholder.
Dokumentation & Weiterbildung: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investor Documents wie Data Books und Due-Diligence-Berichten und entwickelst dein Wissen zu neuen Technologien und Methoden kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Skillset:


Sehr guter Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finance, Accounting oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Fachwissen
Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy [[DELETE IF NOT RELEVANT]]

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Arbeite eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, um einheitliche Reporting-Standards und Best Practices im Bereich Retail Media Analytics voranzutreiben.

Du bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) mit.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, E-Commerce oder datengetriebener Herstellerberatung.

Title: Pricing Analyst, Global Fuels
Description:
Job Description

Pricing Analyst, Global Fuels

Location: Berlin, Hague or Brussels

Job Description Summary

As a Pricing Analyst within Global Fuels, this role supports Business Units in Europe by applying pricing analytics, pricing fundamentals, and structured methodologies to improve the quality, consistency, and execution of pricing decisions. The role partners closely with Business Unit fuel teams and the global capability function to enable data-driven, scalable pricing practices that support commercial performance.

Role Purpose

This role enables effective, consistent, and data-driven pricing decisions across Business Units in Europe by translating analytical insights and pricing fundamentals into practical pricing recommendations and capability improvements.

This role contributes to pricing outcomes through analysis, methodology development, training, and stakeholder enablement. Final pricing ownership remains with Business Units; this role influences decisions through insight, expertise, and structured support.

Key Responsibilities


Apply pricing analytics and pricing fundamentals to support pricing decisions across Business Units.
Enable adoption of standardized pricing methodologies through clear documentation, training, and change management.
Generate actionable pricing insights from internal and external data sources to improve decision quality and consistency.
Support data quality and analytical readiness for pricing models and tools.
Provide ongoing analytical support to Business Units by responding to day‑to‑day fuel pricing–related questions.
Monitor and help maintain the health, accuracy, and performance of fuel pricing tools and adjacent systems to ensure reliable execution.
Proactively identify pricing, system, or data issues through trend analysis and user feedback.
Partner with Global Technology and Data Science teams to diagnose root causes and drive timely resolution of issues.
Translate recurring issues into sustainable system enhancements, process improvements, or targeted training materials.
Collaborate with Business Unit teams, Global Tech, Data Science, and external vendors to support scalable execution.
Deliver clear pricing insights via reports, dashboards, and presentations tailored to non-technical stakeholders.


Experience & Background

Relevant experience may come from fuel or non-fuel environments, including pricing, revenue management, merchandising, category management, real estate analytics, site economics, retail or supply chain analytics, finance, FP&A, consulting, or commercial strategy roles.

What matters most is demonstrated ability to apply pricing logic, pricing fundamentals, and data analysis to real-world commercial decisions.

Competencies And Skills


Analytical thinking and strong grounding in pricing fundamentals
Commercial awareness and pricing judgment
Technical adaptability and learning agility
Ability to influence without formal authority
Clear communication, facilitation, and training for non‑technical audiences
Practical judgment to translate analysis into workable, real‑world recommendations


Why work with us


ACT is a proud receiver Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA)
Possibility of enrolling in stock purchase plan.
Employee discount on fuel.
A nice working atmosphere where we value our employees with access to modern work tools and office space.
The opportunity to develop yourself and grow in an international company: 'As you grow, we grow together.'
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and to evolve professionally in a fast-growing company.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience
Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate


Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re on the road to a net-zero future, and thanks to our partnership with ESB, we’re well on the way. We’re customer-centric, tech-led, and passionate about sustainability.

We’re driven to do our best for our customers, for each other, and for our planet. That’s why we’ve built a workplace culture that’s supportive, empowering, inclusive, and full of opportunities to grow and make an impact.

Clear
Honest
Ambitious
Inquisitive
Caring
Sustainable

Line manage 2 direct reports (mid/junior Analysts), working collaboratively with the Data Team Lead.
Utilize advanced SQL skills to extract, clean, and analyse complex datasets, providing meaningful insights.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, develop analytical solutions, and drive data-driven decision-making.
Design and document curated Data Warehouse tables to be handed to our Data Engineering team for implementation.
Define metrics that are suited to business monitoring at various levels.
Create clear and compelling data visualizations and reports to communicate insights to stakeholders at all levels.
Support the business in ad-hoc data analysis and data supply covering auditing, marketing campaigns and customer segmentation.
Input and guide on new standards to improve our delivery of dashboards, reports, and insights.
Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analysis and data science.
Contribute as part of an agile team with sprint planning sessions and daily stand ups.
Communicate status, blockers, and progress in a clear and concise manner.


You’re a great match if:


You have a Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience; Master's degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) as a Data Analyst or similar role with a strong focus on advanced SQL skills. Experience within the Energy Supply Industry will be favourable.
Data Warehouse design experience using industry methodologies will be highly favourable.
Demonstrated experience in delivering complex data projects, with a portfolio showcasing your work.
Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI)
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with large, messy datasets to extract valuable insights.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to drive projects from inception to completion.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities with a keen attention to detail.
A proactive and collaborative attitude, with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

Smart Working Charters:


Hybrid Working – Every team has its own SPARK Working Charter. Ask your Talent Partner for more details.


Growth & Development


Dedicated Learning & Development Team – Supporting your development through workshops, coaching and learning opportunities.
Learning Platform – Access thousands of learning resources to help you build new skills and support your career development.
Educational Sponsorships – Supporting professional development through initiatives such as Code First Girls.


Pay & Reward


Up to 10% Performance Bonus – Based on both company and personal performance.
Annual Salary Reviews – Helping ensure we remain competitive in the market.
Real Living Wage Employer – Proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer.


Time Off That Matters


Your Birthday Off – Because birthdays should be celebrated.
Three So Giving Days – Paid time to support a cause that's important to you.
Enhanced Family Leave – Supporting you through every stage of family life.


Health & Wellbeing


Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – Confidential support available 24/7, 365 days a year, including access to professional guidance and structured counselling support.
Wellbeing Resources via Perkbox – Access a range of wellbeing articles, tools and guidance, alongside employee perks and discounts, all in one place.
Physical Wellbeing – Free eye tests and annual flu vaccinations.
Menopause Policy – Providing support and guidance for colleagues experiencing menopause.


Belonging & Recognition


Affinity Groups – Connect with colleagues through our employee-led communities.
Monthly Social Events – Bringing teams together and creating opportunities to connect.
Charitable Fundraising – Supporting the communities we're proud to be part of.


🧩 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we encourage applications from everyone, and we will ensure fair and accessible recruitment for all. At So Energy, we’re committed to cultivating an environment that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We are a global community, and we believe our unique qualities should be celebrated as they are critical to our innovation. It’s essential to us that you bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or otherwise. Inclusion isn’t just an initiative at So Energy. We strive to embed it throughout our entire culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
📍Location: London - Hybrid (3 days) or UK Remote

📈 Reporting to: Head of Data

💚 Role type: Permanent / Full-time

As a Data Analyst at Wuffes, you'll be the analyst the business brings its commercial questions to - turning data into the answers that drive decisions. You'll partner with Growth, Marketplace, Finance, Digital Product and CX on what to test, what it's worth, and whether it worked, and publish a substantial piece of analysis every month that names the decision it informs. The dashboards and data models that make those answers repeatable are yours too, but they're the means, not the point.

You'll work in our own codebase rather than a BI tool. In early 2026 we moved off our previous BI tool onto self-hosted dashboards we build ourselves, hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and backed by BigQuery and Dataform. It's AI-first: you write the spec, Claude Code writes most of the code, and you review, validate and ship it.

📒 Your responsibilities:


Answer the commercial questions the business is deciding on - acquisition efficiency, retention and lifetime value, pricing, promotions, product launches, channel mix - starting from the recommendation, not the chart.
Publish a substantial piece of analysis every month, naming the decision it informs and the value at stake.
Act as the embedded analyst for a part of the business (most likely Growth and Retention, plus marketplaces), close enough to know what's coming before it lands as a request.
Design and read measurement: hypotheses, control groups, duration and decision rules agreed before launch, with results logged back to the warehouse rather than left in a vendor tool.
Build and maintain the dashboards the business runs on, from specification through to production, and model data in BigQuery using Dataform.
Own our core metric definitions and keep them consistent - one definition, one implementation, one owner - and reconcile to source systems to catch issues before stakeholders do.
Review AI-generated code, your own and others', before it ships.
Enable self-serve across the business: warehouse and AI access, metric and dashboard catalogues, training.


✅ What you bring:


3–5 years in analytics in a D2C, eCommerce or high-growth environment.
Commercial fluency - comfortable with contribution margin, CAC and payback, cohort retention and lifetime value, and able to hold your own with a CFO or growth lead on what a number means for the P&L.
Strong SQL and experience with a modern cloud warehouse (BigQuery preferred) and a layered modelling tool (Dataform or dbt).
Genuinely AI-native: you already work with AI coding and analysis tools daily, can write a specification an agent can follow, and review its output sceptically rather than shipping it (we use Claude and Claude Code currently but are happy to experiment).
Able to review code you didn't write and spot a logic or data quality error before it reaches a dashboard; comfortable in Git/GitHub day to day and with enough Python to read, debug and extend existing scripts.
Experimentation literacy - you know what makes a result trustworthy and have the confidence to say a test can't be read.
Curiosity and pragmatism: fast to a directionally correct answer, with the judgement to know when exact is required, and excellent written communication for a remote, senior audience.


💚 Perks of the Pack:


Time to recharge - 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) to reset, relax and adventure
Health & dental cash plan - Everyday health and dental bills covered, because looking after our people comes first
Core hours / Hybrid working - Our set office days are Monday, Wednesday and Friday, with core hours of 10am-4pm.
Dog friendly office - Obviously! Bring your pup to work with you.
Remote working - Fancy a change? Work from anywhere (time-zone permitting) for two weeks in summer and two weeks in winter
Bike to work scheme - Ditch the commute stress and cycle to work
Enhanced family leave - More support for life’s important moments and milestones
Pension scheme - Enroll in the Wuffes pension scheme


If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact us - we will always be happy to help.

Performance Data Analyst (SEND)

Job Summary:

Are you passionate about using data to improve outcomes for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)? Do you thrive in a high-impact analytical role where your work directly informs strategic decision-making and service transformation?

This is an exciting opportunity to help transform SEND services through data and intelligence. You will work closely with senior leaders and partners to improve outcomes for children and young people across Ealing.

Ealing Council have an exciting new opportunity as Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) available on a full time. We are seeking a skilled and motivated Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) to join our Schools Data, Performance and Intelligence team. The post holder will play a key role in supporting SEND services by delivering high-quality insight and ensuring statutory reporting is accurate and timely, including SEN2.

In this role you will also contribute to shaping data systems, supporting SEND reforms, and enabling senior leaders to make informed decisions that improve outcomes for residents.

We strive to create communities where everyone can live a long, happy, and healthy life, full of pride and identity. We aim to create an environment where every child can reach their potential and achieve their dreams.

The Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) role:


Lead statutory returns (including SEN2) ensuring compliance and deadlines are met
Develop and enhance data systems and reporting frameworks
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and inform planning
Produce high-quality dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI)
Provide expert advice on data interpretation and performance
Support forecasting including specialist school place planning
Collaborate with services, ICT and partners to improve data systems
Ensure strong data quality, validation and GDPR compliance


Our ideal Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) will have the below skills and experience:


Advanced skills in Excel, SQL and Power BI
Strong analytical and forecasting capability
Experience working with large datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Experience in SEND, education or public sector

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operational Excellence
Description:
The Senior Insights Data Analyst is a key contributor responsible for delivering complex data analytics projects and providing strategic insights that drive business decisions. Sitting at the intersection of operations, business intelligence, and tech, this role will serve as the driver for fast-paced, complex, and ambitious projects. With a strong command of statistical techniques and tools, this individual works with cross-functional teams to gather data, apply advanced analytical frameworks, and develop actionable insights that align with the company's strategic goals. This role works with minimal supervision, ensuring data accuracy and optimizing business processes through data-driven decision-making.

While not responsible for managing a team, the Senior Insights Analyst mentors junior analysts and collaborates closely with business leaders to deliver impactful results. The ideal candidate brings deep domain knowledge, a proactive mindset, and the confidence to share findings and influence decisions — even when not asked.

What You Will Be Doing


Own and drive projects with minimal supervision, executing complex data queries and advanced analytical frameworks
Transform ambiguous business challenges into viable analytical solutions
Apply statistical techniques and AI to address business challenges, providing clear, data-driven insights to guide decision-making
Effectively structure projects, manage timelines, and provide relevant updates to key stakeholders
Expertly steer meetings and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through visualizations and presentations
Process, transform, and clean large datasets
Understand HF's core products and business model, with a focus on optimizing operations
Mentor junior analysts, providing guidance and support in their development


Who You Are


3+ years experience in reporting, BI, data analysis, or a similar position with an operations focus
Advanced ability to model real-life business operations using assumptions and historical data
Advanced ability to utilize large language models to guide and enhance tasks
Advanced understanding of inferential statistics for advanced analytics
Proficient with SQL, Python, and data visualization tools
Strong autonomy and proactive communication skills, with the confidence to share findings and challenge assumptions unprompted
Curious mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving and expanding knowledge and skills
Domain knowledge relevant to operations (e.g. procurement, inventory management, production, logistics)


What You Will Get In Return


70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
Company pension scheme
Gym membership
Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
Dog friendly office! (London site only)
Nursery support scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Group Life Assurance

Description:
Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for a talented Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will help translate business questions into trusted data products and Power BI dashboards, supporting Salary Finance's mission to help our customers get out of debt faster and save for their future. You'll work alongside senior analysts, engineers and stakeholders across the business building the datasets, reports, and insights that inform decisions and enable safe growth of our loan book. This is a role where you'll grow your craft, contribute to team standards, and see the impact of your work reach real customers.




What you’ll do

Build High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will help the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Support Data Integrity:

You will follow the team's data governance standards and contribute to documentation across your analytical outputs

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
SQL Mastery: Advance level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design.




Who you are

While we embrace diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we’re united by a shared mindset. We look for team members who live these values every day:

Take Ownership: We own the entire journey and see outcomes through from start to finish
Dig Deeper :We ask why, investigate root causes, and build solutions that last
Stronger Together :We choose collaboration, share knowledge freely, and lift each other up
Momentum Matters :We act with purpose, remove blockers, and default to action
Make a Lasting Impact :We think long-term, put people before numbers, and change the system for good




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
Regular company socials & more great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at salaryfinance.com

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A brief summary




Based within our global Media Services function, this role sits in the Assets & Data team and reports to the Head of Assets & Data. The Data Analyst helps the business make better use of its data, with a particular focus on S&OP, asset management and resource planning across the Group.




Using SQL, Power BI and Excel, the role will turn data from our Group systems into useful reporting and insight. A key part of the role is helping people understand what the data is telling us how our assets are being used, where demand is changing and where there may be opportunities to improve utilisation, reduce cost or make better investment decisions.




What you’ll be responsible for

Write and maintain SQL queries to bring together and prepare data from Group business systems for analysis and reporting.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that help the business understand asset utilisation, demand, availability and performance.
Analyse asset, resource and demand planning data to spot trends, capacity issues, under utilisation and opportunities to improve efficiency or reduce cost.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and teams across the business to understand the questions they are trying to answer and turn these into useful analysis and reporting.
Check and reconcile data before it is used in reporting, investigate anything that does not look right and work with the relevant data owners to resolve issues.
Support good data governance by helping to keep definitions, standards and quality checks consistent across asset and master data.
Keep clear, practical documentation for key reports, dashboards, calculations and recurring analysis so that others can understand how they work and pick them up when needed.
Work with IT where reporting depends on changes to systems, data access or integrations. The role will help define what the business needs from its data, with IT retaining responsibility for system architecture, security, access controls and technical infrastructure.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and business teams to improve the information held in operational systems, including highlighting gaps, inconsistencies or unclear data ownership.
Provide regular and ad hoc analysis to support S&OP, asset planning, investment decisions, business cases and improvement activity across the Group.
Look for sensible ways to make reporting and analysis quicker and easier, including automation and appropriate use of AI tools, while making sure outputs are checked and company data is handled appropriately.

Requirements

Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience, together with at least two years' experience in a data analyst, BI analyst or similar role.
Strong working knowledge of SQL and confidence using it to query, combine and manipulate data.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with a good understanding of data modelling, measures and how to present information clearly.
Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and working with larger datasets.
Experience of cleaning and checking data, including dealing with duplicates, missing information and inconsistencies.
A good understanding of databases and data structures, with enough technical knowledge to work confidently with IT and system specialists.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills. You should be interested in what sits behind the numbers and able to explain what the data means, rather than simply producing a report.
Able to work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and explain findings clearly to people who may not be data specialists.
Good attention to detail and a practical approach to keeping reports, calculations and supporting documentation organised and up to date.
Commercially aware, with an interest in how asset utilisation, demand, capacity and investment decisions affect the wider business.
Comfortable using AI and other productivity tools where they are useful, while checking outputs and following company requirements around data security.
Able to manage priorities, work well with colleagues across different teams and countries, and respond calmly when something is time sensitive.
The role supports teams across the Group. From time to time, some flexibility may be needed to




General responsibilities

Play an active part in improving how the team and wider business work. Follow Company policies, information security requirements and the processes and controls relevant to the role. This job description covers the main responsibilities of the role but is not exhaustive and may change as the business and team develop.
