Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.



This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time, term-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Senior Data Analyst-(Re)Insurance- SQL, Power BI, Azure technologies
Description:
Introduction

At Gallagher Re, we bring clarity to complexity by helping clients around the world make confident, data-driven decisions in a rapidly evolving risk landscape. Here, you’ll be part of a team that leverages world-class analytics and deep reinsurance expertise to deliver strategic advisory services and transactional excellence. Together, we transform advanced insights and market intelligence into strategies that protect businesses, drive performance, and shape the future of reinsurance. We’re a community of decision makers, future shapers, and trusted experts working side by side to deliver meaningful impact through innovative thinking and practical solutions. At Gallagher Re, your curiosity is welcomed, your growth is championed, and your work truly matters. This is a place where you'll have the freedom to explore new ideas, take ownership of your career, and collaborate with people who are as driven and inquisitive as you are.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our growing data and analytics team. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with underwriting, operations, claims, and finance stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will bring proven experience in the (Re)Insurance market, with hands-on experience working with Bordereaux and Delegated Authority data. You will play a key role in transforming complex data into meaningful analysis, improving data quality, and developing reporting solutions that drive operational efficiency and commercial outcomes. Previoous experience and knowldge of working with Data & Analytics in the insurannce industry is essential to be successful in this role.

We offer flexible/hybrid working and you will be expected in our London City office twice a week.

How You'll Make An Impact


Analyse and interpret large, complex datasets to provide business-critical insights and recommendations.
Work with Delegated Authority and Bordereaux data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations using Power BI.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.
Support the development and enhancement of data models, reporting frameworks, and analytical solutions.
Collaborate with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and operational teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Work with cloud-based data platforms, including Azure Data Lake, to support modern data architecture and analytics capabilities.
Identify data quality issues and implement controls and improvements to enhance data integrity.
Provide subject matter expertise on (Re)Insurance data structures, reporting requirements, and market best practices.


About You


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst within (Re)Insurance market is essential.
Extensive knowledge of Bordereaux and Delegated Authority business processes and datasets.
Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimise complex queries.
Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Experience working with Azure Data Lake and cloud-based data environments.
Fantastic analytical, problem-solving, and data visualisation skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Experience translating business requirements into meaningful analytical solutions.
Experience within the London Market insurance environment.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, or master data management principles.
Exposure to Azure Synapse, Data Factory, or other Azure analytics services.
Understanding of underwriting, claims, exposure management, or reinsurance reporting processes.


Compensation And Benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.


Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact


At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. Although this role is listed as full-time, if you’re in a job-share partnership, work reduced hours, or have any other flexible arrangement, please still get in touch. We will also offer reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process if required, so please let us know.

Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

Description:
We are seeking experienced data analysts to join our teams providing data and intelligence across the shipping and energy industries. We deliver actionable data-driven insights across diverse global shipping, trade, offshore, renewables and energy datasets. You will have the opportunity to build on your data analytics skills, and develop deep knowledge in a dynamic and fast-paced industry that sits at the heart of the world economy.




What you’ll be doing:

Use the latest data science tools and techniques for data processing, analysis and visualisation of large, complex data sets
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, plan deliverables, and track implementation with analysts, data engineers and developers
Incorporate advanced AI and algorithms where relevant
Lead implementation of ETL and processing pipelines, data derivation and analysis
Work across teams, support clients and report progress to senior management

You’ll need to have:

3-4 years’ data analytics experience working with complex data models
Ability to update technical and non-technical stakeholders on progress on projects
Experience supervising junior analysts, data engineers and developers
Excellent SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures and spatial
Working knowledge of Python, JSON and DAX
Ability to deliver actionable insights clearly using visualisation tools such as Power BI
Strong numerical, data handling and analytical skills
A degree in a relevant numerate or analytical subject
Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail

We love to see:

Curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques, programming languages and software tools
Appreciation of the wider data science technology landscape including Databricks
Awareness of global trade, economics and statistics




Details:

Salary: Competitive (dependent on experience) plus bonus and benefits

Location: London/Midlands/Hybrid

Number of vacancies: 1-2

Start date: Q3 2026

Closing date: 13th September 2026 (applications accepted and reviewed immediately)




Working at Clarksons Research:

Clarksons Research is the leading global provider of intelligence and research across shipping, trade, offshore and energy. Respected worldwide, the Clarksons Research team of over 175 experts provides powerful analysis, insight, and data through a range of online platforms, reports, valuations, and consultancy work. Clarksons Research is part of the Clarksons Group, the world’s leading integrated shipping services provider and a FTSE 250 company.




Clarksons Research is currently offering exciting opportunities for experienced senior data analysts to join its expanding Analytics team. Successful candidates will join a fast-expanding business offering excellent opportunities for career progression within a supportive organisation with a strong track record of training, mentoring and ensuring people reach their full potential. We offer a competitive range of benefits including 25-days holiday, corporate pension scheme, gym and health programmes, cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and artificial intelligence ("AI") company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect.

We are headquartered in New York and have more than 60,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit www.exlservice.com.




Role Title: Data Analyst

BU/Segment: Analytics

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent




Summary of the role:

EXL is looking for a Data Analyst with a passion for sports who will play a key role in providing analytics support to a client within our Sports, Media and Entertainment practice. Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on fan growth, engagement and lifecycle metrics across international markets.
Monitor campaign and go-to-market (GTM) performance using agreed KPIs and success criteria.
Contribute to regular performance updates for team leads and senior stakeholders.




Campaign & Audience Enablement

Prepare audience segments and data for 1:1 marketing campaigns, including test/control groups.
Support segmentation analysis that helps regional teams deepen fan engagement in local markets.




Data Quality & Collaboration

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) of database changes and updates.
Help data engineering teams with root cause analysis (RCA) of data issues and bugs.
Work with marketing, international and data engineering teams to gather and document business requirements.
Liaise with third-party partners on data needs and definitions.




Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations and window functions.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform: Databricks, AWS or Snowflake.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.

Fancy a Data Analyst role where you're actually in the room when the decisions get made?




We're working with a fast-growing luxury fashion and eCommerce group that's investing heavily in its next stage of growth. At the centre of the business is a membership-led digital platform with a growing customer base and a lot of rich behavioural data to dig into.




They're now building out the data, tech and commercial infrastructure to support that growth, and are looking for a Commercial Data Analyst to be one of the foundational people on that journey.

This isn't a dashboards-into-the-void kind of role. You'll be working directly with senior commercial leadership, using data to understand customer behaviour, spot trends, and answer the questions that are actually driving growth across the business.




What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of analysis across customer, membership, trading and operational performance, including:

Using SQL to interrogate data across multiple systems and datasets
Turning broad commercial questions into clear, useful analysis
Spotting trends and opportunities worth digging into further
Building reporting and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar
Presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and senior stakeholders
Helping define and measure the KPIs that matter as the business scales
Working between Commercial and Technology as the business develops its central data warehouse
Supporting data quality, accuracy and reporting logic as that environment evolves




You won't be expected to architect or build the data warehouse, there's already technical ownership in place. Your job is making sure the data coming out of it is accurate, useful, and able to support real commercial decisions.




What we're looking for

Strong SQL skills and confidence working independently with data
Previous experience working with a data warehouse
Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Strong reporting and trend-analysis experience
The ability to explain data clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders
Commercial curiosity, and the confidence to look beyond the original question




Experience in eCommerce, consumer, subscription, membership, marketplace or app-led businesses would be particularly relevant but we're far more interested in how you think than whether you've used the exact same tech stack before.




Why consider it

This is a newly created role with genuine visibility and room to grow. You'll work closely with the senior leader responsible for Commercial Finance, Strategy and Growth, with regular exposure to the wider leadership team.




You'll also be joining at a point where the group is actively improving how it uses data, consolidating reporting, and building the foundations for its next phase of growth. For someone currently sat in a larger analytics team, this could be your chance to:




Take much broader ownership of your analysis
Work directly with senior decision-makers
See the commercial impact of the insights you produce

Build towards Senior, Manager and potentially broader Data & Analytics leadership as the business scales




Package

Further benefits currently being introduced




If you're technically strong but want your next move to bring more commercial exposure, ownership and progression, get in touch.

What is the job?




We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.




What will you be doing?




Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.
Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.
Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.
Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.
Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.
Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.
Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.




What do you need?




Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.
Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.
A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.
Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.
Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.




What we offer:




Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays
Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave




About Us




Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Adapty, we make it easy for mobile apps to manage in-app purchases and paywalls. We power 20K+ apps, process $3B+ in subscriptions every year, and have been growing fast for the last four years. Our mission is simple: make apps rich.

We are a team of 210+ passionate, product-driven people who love solving big challenges. Backed by top investors like 500 Startups and Surface Ventures, we are building one of mobile's fastest-growing SaaS companies and aiming for number one worldwide.

Why This Role Matters

Adapty's Revenue team is scaling across SDR, Account Executive, Customer Success, and Professional Services. The data that explains how it is doing sits in CRM, billing, invoices, product usage, and marketing tools – and none of it is connected.

This role owns that end to end: pull the data in, model it, and turn it into dashboards and answers. Roughly half the job is engineering – pipelines, dbt models, automation – and half is analysis for the people who run Revenue and Marketing. The backlog is already deep, so the impact starts in week one.

What You'll Do


Build and own the pipelines that bring CRM, billing, invoice, product usage, and marketing data together — Airflow, dbt, n8n, Python.
Model that data into clean, documented, tested layers other people can build on.
Build the dashboards Revenue actually runs on in Metabase: pipeline, quota attainment, new revenue, churn, contraction, expansion, NRR/GRR, customer health.
Connect marketing to revenue: channel and event ROI, CAC, LTV, payback, funnel conversion.
Own data quality: monitoring, tests, and alerts that catch problems before leadership does.
Explain why revenue moved — product, region, segment, channel, billing logic, customer behaviour — not just that it moved.
Build forecasting and risk models: revenue forecast, churn and contraction risk, NRR forecast.


About You


You have built ETL pipelines yourself and kept them running in production – Airflow, dbt, n8n or equivalents.
Excellent SQL (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and strong Python for automation and analysis.
You are comfortable in a BI tool, ideally Metabase, and you build dashboards people actually use.
You know SaaS revenue metrics well: MRR, ARR, NRR, GRR, churn, contraction, expansion, pipeline, quota attainment, cohorts.
You know marketing metrics too: CAC, LTV, payback, channel and event ROI, attribution, funnel conversion.
You understand how SDR, AE, and CS work and how that shows up in revenue.
High ownership: you take a vague business question, clarify it, build the thing, explain the result, and say what to do next.


Nice to have


HubSpot data and HubSpot reporting logic.
Subscription, billing, invoice, or usage-based revenue data.
Churn prediction, customer health scores, or forecasting models that shipped and got used.
Marketing attribution across paid, organic, and events.
BI migration, dashboard governance, and aligning metric definitions across teams.


What's in it for you


Strong product with industry-best metrics. Adapty is among the top 5% fastest-growing SaaS companies.
Exceptional compensation directly tied to your results.
Direct communication and ownership. No bureaucracy, no politics, just impact.
Flexible remote work. Join us from anywhere or work onsite in our Belgrade or London offices.
Professional support. Language learning, sports, health insurance, laptop coverage, and more.

Job Description

Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

Location: Canary Wharf, London

Business Unit: Global Financial Services (GFS)

Vacancy type: Permanent

Working Hours: 9am-5.30pm GMT. Hybrid with 3 days onsite.

The Position

The Senior Data Analyst within CSC Global Financial Services (GFS)'s Insights team will own the delivery of analytics solutions that drive strategic decision-making across the business. This is a hands-on, high-impact role requiring expertise in BI platforms, SQL - combined with the leadership ability to influence stakeholders, and drive data governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Lead complex, cross-functional data analyses to uncover strategic insights that inform commercial, operational, and financial decisions across the Capital Markets business unit.
Independently scope, design, and deliver analytics projects from requirements gathering through to executive presentation - with minimal supervision.


Dashboard & Reporting Architecture


Architect, build, and govern a suite of Domo dashboards and reports serving Leadership, Commercial, Product Operations, and Finance - ensuring scalability, performance, and data accuracy.
Define and enforce dashboard standards, naming conventions, and best practices across the Insights team.


Data Quality & Governance


Define and enforce data quality standards, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes across all analytics outputs.
Document data definitions, lineage, and business logic to support audit readiness and team scalability.


Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership


Serve as a trusted analytics partner to senior stakeholders across Product Operations, Commercial, Finance, and Leadership - translating complex data into clear, executive-ready narratives.
Drive alignment on analytics priorities, manage competing stakeholder requests, and communicate timelines and trade-offs effectively.


Required Skills & Experience:


4-7 years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated track record of leading analytics projects end-to-end in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Prior experience in financial services, capital markets, or fund administration is a strong plus.
Proficiency in Domo - including DataFlows, Beast Mode, Domo Everywhere, and connector management. Power BI or Tableau considered in lieu.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, ETL pipelines, and enterprise data integration (SAP, NetSuite, Denodo a plus).
Exceptional ability to present complex data findings to non-technical and executive audiences with clarity and confidence.
Strong project ownership mindset - able to manage multiple workstreams, set priorities, and deliver without heavy oversight.


Why Join Our Team?


Lead analytics strategy for a high-visibility business unit within a globally recognized financial services organization.
Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge BI and Agentic AI capabilities within Domo, shaping how the team uses AI to accelerate insight delivery.
Work on strategic, high-stakes projects with direct influence on Capital Markets revenue and operational decisions.
Join a collaborative, innovation-driven team that invests in professional growth and values data-driven thinking at every level.

Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Description:
The Role...

We are looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Data Analyst to join our growing Data & Analytics team at Soho House. This role is deeply embedded in both the day-to-day commercial trading operations and the strategic planning side of the business. You’ll partner closely with our FP&A team, supporting business leaders with insight on how our markets are performing, how members are behaving, and helping drive decisions on growth strategy from investment choices to location expansion. A core part of the role is partnering with Finance to develop new reporting and to create and own the KPIs the business relies on to measure performance and make decisions.

Responsibilities


Strategic Analysis & Growth Insight - You’ll partner with the FP&A team and senior stakeholders to deliver analysis that drives growth - supporting long-term planning, business cases, and investment decisions, and uncovering insight into market performance and member behaviour.
Trading Insights & Operational Reporting - You’ll own trading insights and reporting - developing and automating key performance dashboards and maintaining core KPIs. This includes the reporting shared with the Exec team and senior leaders, forming the backbone of how the business reviews performance and makes decisions, and empowering teams to act on data confidently.
Reporting Development & KPI Ownership - You’ll work closely with Finance to develop new management reporting and to define, build, and own the KPIs critical to how the business measures performance. Beyond surfacing numbers, you’ll build and own the underlying data models and pipelines (in dbt) end-to-end, from raw data to the dashboards leaders rely on.
AI Enablement & Self-Serve - You’ll help the business get real value from AI. By owning clean, well-modelled data, you’ll ensure agentic AI tooling (such as Omni’s) runs reliably against trusted data, and support stakeholders in using it to self-serve and answer their own questions.


Requirements

3+ years of experience in a data analyst role - with a track record of delivering clear, actionable insights to business stakeholders and demonstrating a strong grasp of diverse analytical methodologies to solve complex business questions.Strong proficiency in SQL - confident manipulating and interpreting large, complex datasets to drive insights.


Hands-on data development experience - solid grasp of data modelling concepts and analytics pipelines. You’re comfortable building and owning transformations end-to-end, not just querying existing tables.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement - you’re a trusted partner, not just a data builder, and can distill complexity into clear, actionable insight.
Strategic mindset with strong commercial instincts - you understand how businesses operate and where data can create leverage.
Ability to prioritise and adapt across strategic and operational needs - whether it's analysing member behaviour or building a performance snapshot for FP&A and Exec, you switch gears with ease.
Growth mindset - eager to learn, challenge assumptions, and push boundaries, not just execute tasks.


Desirables


Experience with BI Tools & notebooking environments (We use Omni & HEX).
Experience with dbt.
Experience working in or around ERP/finance systems (e.g. Oracle, SAP), with an understanding of reporting transformation.
Working experience of AI tools in day-to-day work (we use Claude).

Title: Data Analyst - AI & Insight
Description:
Data Analyst – AI & Insight

Salary: £50,000 - £65,000 + benefits

Location: London – Hybrid




Our client is a global luxury travel business investing significantly in its Data & AI capability and transforming how analysis is delivered across the organisation. They are building a more AI-first Data & Analytics function, with AI becoming embedded into how the team explores data, writes and reviews code, automates recurring analysis and produces commercial insight.




They are looking for a Data Analyst who combines strong analytical thinking, commercial curiosity and clear communication with a genuine interest in using AI as part of their everyday analytical workflow. This isn’t a traditional reporting or dashboarding role. You’ll use AI alongside tools such as SQL, BigQuery and Python to explore data, solve commercial problems and turn complex customer, marketing, sales and booking data into clear, actionable insight.




The Opportunity

Join a growing Data & Analytics function where AI is becoming fundamental to how analysis is delivered
Develop your use of AI, LLMs, code assistants and increasingly agentic workflows as part of your day-to-day analytical process
Use AI to accelerate data exploration, generate and review code, automate repeatable analysis and validate outputs
Analyse customer, marketing, sales and booking data across BigQuery, HubSpot, GA4 and advertising platforms
Develop your SQL and broader technical capability while working with large and varied datasets
Investigate commercial questions and understand why performance is changing, rather than simply reporting what happened
Turn analysis into clear recommendations for Marketing, CRM, Growth and wider commercial teams
Work closely with senior analysts and the Head of Data & Analytics while taking increasing ownership of your own work
Build towards tackling increasingly complex and ambiguous analytical problems as your experience develops




Responsibilities

Use AI throughout the analytical process to explore data, generate and review code, automate tasks and accelerate analysis
Query and analyse data using SQL and BigQuery, with opportunities to develop your Python capability
Build your understanding of agentic AI workflows and how they can be applied to analytics
Apply human judgement to AI-generated outputs and recognise when findings or code need to be challenged and validated
Identify trends, anomalies and commercial opportunities within customer and business data
Build reusable analysis rather than relying purely on recurring reports and dashboards
Translate findings into clear, commercially relevant recommendations
Communicate insight to stakeholders across Marketing, CRM, Growth, Sales and other commercial teams
Work with senior analysts to develop your analytical judgement, technical capability and problem-solving approach




Your Profile

2+ years' experience within Data Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Customer Analytics, Insights or a related analytical role
Already comfortable using AI within your work and keen to develop significantly further into AI-enabled and agentic ways of working
Curious about using AI for analysis, coding, automation, debugging and validation rather than simply basic chat-based Q&A
Some hands-on SQL experience and the ability to understand what a query is doing, even if you aren’t yet an advanced SQL developer
Python experience is useful but not essential
Strong analytical thinking and curiosity around why numbers move and what they mean for the business
Comfortable working with raw data and developing your technical skills
Good communication skills with the ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable taking ownership while also learning from more experienced members of the team
Experience within travel, luxury or another considered-purchase business would be advantageous but is not essential
Broader commercial, customer, product, marketing and insight analytics backgrounds are all relevant
Most importantly, you’ll be excited by the opportunity to develop at the forefront of AI-enabled analytics rather than looking for a traditional reporting-focused role




How to apply

To apply for this outstanding opportunity, please contact Daniel Haymes at Pivotal for a confidential discussion on 07442871117 or email daniel@pivotallondon.co.uk.




Pivotal is an equal opportunities employer and we encourage applications regardless of ethnic origin, race, religious beliefs, age, disability, gender or sexual orientation, and any other protected status as required by applicable law.

Analyse sales pipeline data to support forecasting for future intakes, including segmentation by nationality, conversion stage, and visa risk factors.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools using Microsoft Excel and Power BI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Evaluate team and regional performance against agreed KPIs and provide insights to support continuous improvement.

Maintain and update the agent database, ensuring data is accurate, complete, up to date, and compliant with relevant requirements.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and data processes using Python and other appropriate tools.
Establish and maintain robust data validation and quality-control processes.


Commission & Agent Operations


Manage, in collaboration with relevant team members, the end-to-end commission process for agents, including tracking, validation, reconciliation, and coordination with Finance to ensure timely payments.
Ensure commission data is accurate and aligned with agreed commercial terms and performance records.

Partner with senior leadership, regional heads, sales teams, Finance, and other departments to understand business requirements and provide data-driven solutions.
Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Support a culture of data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across the organisation.

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

Strong experience working with CRM systems, databases, and data management processes.
Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in data handling, reporting, and analysis.
Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, pipelines, conversion rates, forecasting, and KPI management.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience supporting senior leadership.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
Ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams and departments.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight reporting deadlines.
A continuous-improvement mindset, with a focus on increasing efficiency, automation, and data quality.

Experience working with CRM systems and managing large or complex datasets.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud Analytics
Description:
Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role As a Senior Data Analyst in Global Fraud Analytics, you will lead the charge in protecting our platform from evolving threats while driving an AI-first analytics culture. Working with cross-functional partners, you will deliver data-driven solutions to safeguard our customers, couriers, and partners.

In this role, you will care for our platform ecosystem by balancing cutting-edge AI automation with rigorous sanity checks. Through teamwork, you will build innovative multi-agent systems and AI workflows to simplify operations and elevate fraud mitigation excellence.

These are some of the key components to the position:


Analyze complex datasets using SQL and AI tools to detect payment fraud, voucher abuse, and emerging typologies.
Aim high by designing and coordinating multi-agent AI ecosystems to automate end-to-end fraud detection.
Drive excellence in change management, mentoring colleagues to transform manual workflows into automated AI pipelines.
Establish robust quality control guardrails and sanity checks on all automated outputs for maximum accuracy.
Conceptualize AI models to test fraud rules and simulate vulnerabilities to continuously improve platform security.
Design, implement, and monitor fraud rules to minimize financial loss while maintaining a seamless customer experience.
Create insightful Looker/Tableau dashboards and AI-enhanced reporting to present clear narratives to senior stakeholders.
Collaborate across Agile teams using Jira to prioritize sprint deliverables and manage AI-driven integration projects.


What will you bring to the team?


Experience in data analytics within e-commerce, fintech, or payment processing environments.
Proven capability to orchestrate multi-agent AI systems and automate data analysis workflows.
Specialized knowledge of fraud typologies including chargebacks, payment fraud, and promotional abuse.
Technical proficiency in SQL (BigQuery) and advanced visualization tools like Tableau.
Strong commitment to achieving goals by implementing guardrails and validation checks for AI-generated data.
Ability to develop an understanding of internal and external partners to translate complex data into concise narratives.
Collaborative mindset to act responsibly while making a lasting impact across multi-market environments.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies, Jira, and database management principles.
Curiosity and drive to aim higher, solving complex analytical problems with innovative solutions.

Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belongings No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. Description:
Energy Data Analyst | Permanent | Hybrid – Brighton | up to £32,000

Are you someone looking to build a career in data and have a passion for sustainability?

PT Renewables is exclusively partnered with a growing, specialist consultancy that helps organisations get a grip on their energy, water and carbon data.

They’re now looking for a new Energy Data Analyst to join the team, being in the midst of energy, carbon and usage data with real scope for someone to continue to grow into it.

If you’re someone who enjoys digging into a spreadsheet until you find out why the numbers don’t add up, this could be a great next move.

Own energy data end-to-end for a client portfolio – collection, invoicing, and producing journals through SystemsLink.
Work with clients and suppliers to investigate and resolve data issues; electricity metering knowledge (ideally MHHS/AMR exposure) is a plus
Build Power BI reports covering consumption, spend and carbon data, including live reporting
Spot anomalies and gaps, and follow them through to a proper explanation, not just a flag
Act as a genuine client advocate – building relationships and challenging information that doesn’t add up


The role will naturally expand into more carbon reporting and wider datasets as your confidence and skills develop.

About You


Some background in energy or utilities – brokerage, supplier, consultancy or a wider utility/data environment
Naturally curious and detail-oriented, with a genuine interest in the “why” behind the data
Confident communicator who can build relationships with clients and suppliers
SystemsLink experience is a strong plus; Power BI exposure helps too


Package & Benefits


£32,000 salary
Hybrid working from Brighton office
Structured onboarding, with first six months focused on learning the role and systems
Funded Data Analyst course once established, with a route into a more technical role
Remote working flexibility once settled in
Exposure to live client portfolios, carbon reporting and M&V

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact


Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.
Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.
Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.
Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.
Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.
Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.
Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.


Your background


A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.
Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.
Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.
Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.


The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing
Description:
At SheMed, our mission is to revolutionise women’s health by providing accessible and personalised solutions tailored specifically for women. We are a startup consisting of enthusiastic people who are committed to empowering women with the knowledge and tools they need to take control of their health and well-being.

SheMed is an innovative and advanced weight loss programme that is groundbreaking in the world of women’s health. We have an unwavering dedication to quality care, and strive to create a supportive and compassionate community where every woman can thrive and achieve optimal health. In doing so, we believe SheMed will be a strong force in closing the women’s health gap.

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded Senior Data Analyst, Marketing to become a key partner to the marketing team at SheMed.

This role will be embedded within marketing, helping the team make smarter, faster, data-led decisions across acquisition, retention, customer journeys, and campaign performance. You will drive the measurement of key growth channels, including Meta, Google, and influencer partnerships, and provide clear insight into what is working, what is not, and where we should focus next.

You will play a critical role in connecting marketing behaviour with wider business performance, including subscription metrics, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and retention.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent commercial judgement and communication skills. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, but equally confident translating your analysis into clear, non-technical narratives for senior leadership.




Please note: This is an office-based role, Monday to Friday, 9am – 6pm. We are based in Euston, London.




What You’ll Work On

Own marketing performance measurement across channels including Meta, Google, paid social, affiliates, and influencer partnerships.
Develop attribution frameworks to evaluate acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue performance.
Partner with marketing teams to optimise campaigns, audience targeting, creative performance, and budget allocation.
Analyse the end-to-end customer journey to identify drop-off points, behavioural trends, and growth opportunities.
Deliver insights to improve conversion, onboarding, CRM, lifecycle communications, retention, and customer value.
Own reporting and analysis for key subscription KPIs including CAC, LTV, payback period, churn, retention, conversion rate, subscription growth, and channel ROI.
Apply advanced analytics using SQL, Python, or R for cohort analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and Marketing Mix Modelling.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Tableau to support data-driven decision-making.
Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Use SQL and dbt to develop trusted, scalable data models and analytics infrastructure.
Collaborate with data, marketing, product, medical, finance, and leadership teams to align insights with business priorities.
Support analysis of customer engagement and health outcomes in partnership with clinical and product teams.
Proactively identify opportunities, challenge assumptions with evidence, and help teams move from data to decisions.




What We’re Looking For

3–5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, commercial analytics, or a similar data-focused role.
Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, ideally within D2C healthcare, subscription, consumer health, wellness, ecommerce, or a startup environment.
Strong experience analysing paid marketing performance across channels such as Meta, Google, paid search, paid social, influencer, affiliates, or CRM.
Experience owning and reporting on subscription or customer growth metrics, such as CAC, LTV, retention, churn, payback period, and cohort performance.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
Experience using dbt for data transformation, modelling, testing, and documentation.
Strong Tableau experience, including building dashboards for senior stakeholders and non-technical users.
Experience using Python or R for advanced analysis, predictive modelling, forecasting, or statistical modelling.
Ability to translate complex datasets into clear, non-technical narratives that influence senior decision-making.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Marketing Mix Modelling or incrementality testing (Desireable)
Experience with PostHog, Braze, or similar product analytics and CRM platforms (Desireable)
Experience working with clinical, health, patient, or outcomes data (Desireable)




What We Offer

A mission-driven team focused on closing the women’s health gap
Competitive Salary
25 days holiday
Breakfast and all day snacks
Monthly socials
Health care Cash Plan including physio, digital clinical appointments and wellbeing for you, your partner and children
£80 contribution to noise cancelling headphones
Life insurance cover of 4x salary
Pension contribution matched up to 5%
Cycle to work scheme




Please note that offers of employment are subject to receipt of satisfactory references and a enhanced DBS check.




WORKING AT SHEMED

Whether you work in one of our amazing offices, clinics or part of our remote clinician workforce, SheMed is highly collaborative and fun! You’ll have a chance to work in a fast-paced environment with experienced industry leaders. We have a learning environment where you can make an impact.




Who We Are

At SheMed our people aren’t just part of a team, they’re part of something bigger. We’re a vibrant community of creative thinkers and doers, forging the way for a new generation of healthcare. We’re only as good as our people. So, finding the best people is everything to us. We serve millions, but we choose our people one at a time…




DIVERSITY

We believe that difference inspires a better, healthier world. That’s why it’s at the heart of everything we do. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

We are seeking experienced data analysts to join our teams providing data and intelligence across the shipping and energy industries. We deliver actionable data-driven insights across diverse global shipping, trade, offshore, renewables and energy datasets. You will have the opportunity to build on your data analytics skills, and develop deep knowledge in a dynamic and fast-paced industry that sits at the heart of the world economy.




What you’ll be doing:

Use the latest data science tools and techniques for data processing, analysis and visualisation of large, complex data sets
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, plan deliverables, and track implementation with analysts, data engineers and developers
Incorporate advanced AI and algorithms where relevant
Lead implementation of ETL and processing pipelines, data derivation and analysis
Work across teams, support clients and report progress to senior management

You’ll need to have:

3-4 years’ data analytics experience working with complex data models
Ability to update technical and non-technical stakeholders on progress on projects
Experience supervising junior analysts, data engineers and developers
Excellent SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures and spatial
Working knowledge of Python, JSON and DAX
Ability to deliver actionable insights clearly using visualisation tools such as Power BI
Strong numerical, data handling and analytical skills
A degree in a relevant numerate or analytical subject
Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail

We love to see:

Curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques, programming languages and software tools
Appreciation of the wider data science technology landscape including Databricks
Awareness of global trade, economics and statistics




Details:

Salary: Competitive (dependent on experience) plus bonus and benefits

Location: London/Midlands/Hybrid

Number of vacancies: 1-2

Start date: Q3 2026

Closing date: 13th September 2026 (applications accepted and reviewed immediately)




Working at Clarksons Research:

Clarksons Research is the leading global provider of intelligence and research across shipping, trade, offshore and energy. Respected worldwide, the Clarksons Research team of over 175 experts provides powerful analysis, insight, and data through a range of online platforms, reports, valuations, and consultancy work. Clarksons Research is part of the Clarksons Group, the world’s leading integrated shipping services provider and a FTSE 250 company.




Clarksons Research is currently offering exciting opportunities for experienced senior data analysts to join its expanding Analytics team. Successful candidates will join a fast-expanding business offering excellent opportunities for career progression within a supportive organisation with a strong track record of training, mentoring and ensuring people reach their full potential. We offer a competitive range of benefits including 25-days holiday, corporate pension scheme, gym and health programmes, cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans.




Think you’d be a good fit?

Send a CV and cover letter to Apeksha Mehta at recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512.




We also accept applications via LinkedIn though priority is given to applications received by email. Candidates with prior shipping industry experience are encouraged to contact us via email; we would be happy to arrange a discussion with a senior manager or director to explore opportunities for more experienced hires and how your background could best fit within the business.




To prioritise your application for immediate review or to highlight relevant maritime or energy industry experience, please send a CV and letter to recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512. 




For more information about us, have a look at clarksons.net/about-us and clarksons.com/research




What to expect from us: We believe in human insights and all applications are reviewed by real people, not algorithms. We know your time is valuable and aim to keep to a two-stage process where possible.

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent

Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Campaign & Audience Enablement

Prepare audience segments and data for 1:1 marketing campaigns, including test/control groups.
Support segmentation analysis that helps regional teams deepen fan engagement in local markets.




Data Quality & Collaboration

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) of database changes and updates.
Help data engineering teams with root cause analysis (RCA) of data issues and bugs.
Work with marketing, international and data engineering teams to gather and document business requirements.
Liaise with third-party partners on data needs and definitions.




Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations and window functions.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform: Databricks, AWS or Snowflake.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences




Skills and Personal attributes we would like to have:

Experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Experience in marketing, CRM or customer analytics.
Knowledge of consent management, identity resolution or UK GDPR.
Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.
Passion for sport and an understanding of global fan cultures.

A competitive salary with a generous bonus, private healthcare, critical illness life assurance at 4 x your annual salary, income protection insurance, and a rewarding pension.

At EXL, we offer a flexible hybrid working model that allows employees to live a balanced, healthy lifestyle while strengthening our culture of collaboration

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
GoHenry Data Analyst




GoHenry is a UK-based fintech company created by parents to pioneer financial education. More recently, GoHenry moved into Europe and the US by joining forces with French fintech company PixPay and US investing app, Acorns.




Together, Acorns, PixPay, and GoHenry have over 6 million members across 5 countries.

We are focused on empowering families with engaging money management tools, educational content, and a seamless product experience that creates financial well-being from birth to adulthood. Join us on our mission to make every kid smart with money!




GoHenry is seeking an experienced and self-driven Data Analyst to be a pivotal part of our Data team, providing insights that drive our product forward and help millions of kids and teens build good financial habits. Key technologies are BigQuery, Dataform, Tableau, Veezoo, Amplitude and Monte Carlo.




This role is based in our London office, with the flexibility to work remotely provided you are willing to travel to London when needed. You will be a key member of the Data team, a vibrant group of analysts and engineers dedicated to mastering our craft.




What you will do at GoHenry:

Work with people across the business to deeply understand their objectives, providing analysis and insight to drive the product forwards.
Present critical insights and strategic recommendations to others in a way that is impactful but easy to understand.
Proactively perform in-depth data analysis to identify and understand anomalies.
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to structure, run, and analyse A/B tests, using statistical techniques to ensure reliable findings that improve the customer experience.
Design, build, test, deploy and monitor data models and semantic models, following all best practices and team standards and processes.
Share knowledge with other team members, playing an active role in the wider data team.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data practices, taking on new challenges as the team grows.




What you will bring to GoHenry:




Essential:

Very strong knowledge of SQL in a data warehouse environment.
Experience building robust and compelling dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau.
Good working knowledge of product experimentation techniques and statistical methods.
Experience using a data transformation tool such as dbt or Dataform.
A curiosity and desire to learn how GoHenry works, and gain a deep understanding of the product structure and business models.
Previous experience working as a data analyst, ideally in a B2C environment.
A team player fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
A hunger to continually improve yourself and others, using the latest technologies such as Claude Code to increase impact.




Desirable:

Good working knowledge of BigQuery.
Experience building semantic models / knowledge graphs, or a desire to learn.
Experience working with event analytic platforms such as Amplitude.




What's in it for you?

All the essentials you would expect, including a workplace pension plan, 33 days of holiday (including public holidays), & great company events local & abroad!

Other Offers:

GoFlex - Work from Home, Office, or a mix of both
Your Birthday Day off
25 days annual leave, in addition to 8 UK bank holidays
An excellent Induction & onboarding program with ongoing learning & development throughout your career
A choice between Bupa Health Cash Plan or Bupa Private Medical
Death in service – 4x your annual salary from month 1
Physical and Mental Wellbeing support and platforms for you and your family
Family-friendly leave policies
Enhanced maternity leave – 20 weeks full basic pay after 2 years’ service and 26 weeks full basic pay after 3 years’ service
Paternity leave – 4 weeks full pay after probation
Salary Sacrifice options

We’re on a mission to help every kid be smart with money. Our goal? Create generations of independent, confident young adults, armed with money skills that will set them up for life.




How we do it:

We place the power in the hands of young people, giving them the tools they need to master the financial ropes for themselves. They can spend, save, earn, and give with GoHenry’s prepaid debit card and app – because learning through doing really works (and it’s more fun!). All while our unique built-in controls give parents total peace of mind.




We’re proud to say...

We ranked #38 in Newsweek's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces in the UK in 2023

Our kids and parents have donated over £500,000 of their own money to NSPCC via their GoHenry accounts




But we’re still growing, and that’s why we need you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Adapty, we make it easy for mobile apps to manage in-app purchases and paywalls. We power 20K+ apps, process $3B+ in subscriptions every year, and have been growing fast for the last four years. Our mission is simple: make apps rich.

We are a team of 210+ passionate, product-driven people who love solving big challenges. Backed by top investors like 500 Startups and Surface Ventures, we are building one of mobile's fastest-growing SaaS companies and aiming for number one worldwide.

Why This Role Matters

Adapty's Revenue team is scaling across SDR, Account Executive, Customer Success, and Professional Services. The data that explains how it is doing sits in CRM, billing, invoices, product usage, and marketing tools – and none of it is connected.

This role owns that end to end: pull the data in, model it, and turn it into dashboards and answers. Roughly half the job is engineering – pipelines, dbt models, automation – and half is analysis for the people who run Revenue and Marketing. The backlog is already deep, so the impact starts in week one.

What You'll Do


Build and own the pipelines that bring CRM, billing, invoice, product usage, and marketing data together — Airflow, dbt, n8n, Python.
Model that data into clean, documented, tested layers other people can build on.
Build the dashboards Revenue actually runs on in Metabase: pipeline, quota attainment, new revenue, churn, contraction, expansion, NRR/GRR, customer health.
Connect marketing to revenue: channel and event ROI, CAC, LTV, payback, funnel conversion.
Own data quality: monitoring, tests, and alerts that catch problems before leadership does.
Explain why revenue moved — product, region, segment, channel, billing logic, customer behaviour — not just that it moved.
Build forecasting and risk models: revenue forecast, churn and contraction risk, NRR forecast.


About You


You have built ETL pipelines yourself and kept them running in production – Airflow, dbt, n8n or equivalents.
Excellent SQL (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and strong Python for automation and analysis.
You are comfortable in a BI tool, ideally Metabase, and you build dashboards people actually use.
You know SaaS revenue metrics well: MRR, ARR, NRR, GRR, churn, contraction, expansion, pipeline, quota attainment, cohorts.
You know marketing metrics too: CAC, LTV, payback, channel and event ROI, attribution, funnel conversion.
You understand how SDR, AE, and CS work and how that shows up in revenue.
High ownership: you take a vague business question, clarify it, build the thing, explain the result, and say what to do next.


Nice to have


HubSpot data and HubSpot reporting logic.
Subscription, billing, invoice, or usage-based revenue data.
Churn prediction, customer health scores, or forecasting models that shipped and got used.
Marketing attribution across paid, organic, and events.
BI migration, dashboard governance, and aligning metric definitions across teams.


What's in it for you


Strong product with industry-best metrics. Adapty is among the top 5% fastest-growing SaaS companies.
Exceptional compensation directly tied to your results.
Direct communication and ownership. No bureaucracy, no politics, just impact.
Flexible remote work. Join us from anywhere or work onsite in our Belgrade or London offices.
Professional support. Language learning, sports, health insurance, laptop coverage, and more.
