Title: Data Analyst (Tech Insurance Operations)
Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically capable Data Analyst to support the development of a data-driven claims function. This role will report directly to the Head of Claims and will work closely with TPAs, and Vave’s Underwriting, Operations, and Technology teams.

The Data Analyst will be responsible for extracting, analysing, reconciling, and interpreting claims data to support operational oversight, reserving discipline, TPA performance, underwriting feedback, and portfolio profitability. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with SQL, Excel, data validation, reporting and claims analysis

This is a hands-on role for someone who can transform data into insight, and help the business make better claims, underwriting, and financial decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis


Analyse claims data from internal systems, TPAs data feeds, bordereaux reports, and data warehouses.
Use SQL to query claims databases, validate data quality, build recurring extracts, and support ad hoc analysis.
Work within an Azure Databricks environment, utilising SQL, and Python skills to automate claims analysis and oversight reporting.
Operational reporting, severity analysis, reserving reviews, claims feedback for underwriting.
Identify and investigate data quality concerns.
Translate claims data into clear insights, trends, exceptions, and recommended actions.


Claims MI, Reporting & Dashboards


Shape recurring claims management information, dashboards, KPI packs, and executive reporting.
Track and report on key claim metrics.
Support the creation of board, capacity partner, underwriting, and actuarial reporting packs.


Actuarial & Underwriting Support


Support reserve reviews, loss development analysis, large loss monitoring, data reconciliations, and claims trend analysis.
Partner with Underwriting to provide claim insights that inform risk selection, pricing, appetite, policy wording, exclusions, endorsement, and portfolio strategy.
Support development of claims feedback loops that connect loss experience back to underwriting action.


Rules Engine, Scoring & Claims Intelligence


Support the build-out of claims rules, escalation triggers, severity scoring models and exception reporting.
Participate in UAT for claims systems, rules engines, dashboards, portals, data feeds, and workflow tools.
Translate business requirements from Claims into technical data logic, SQL predicates, reporting rules, and test cases.


Required Experience


3+ years of experience in data analytics within the financial/insurance sector
Ability to work with incomplete, inconsistent, or complex data sources.
Strong SQL querying and data manipulation skills.
Advanced Excel and data reconciliation skills.
Preferred knowledge of any of the following: laims analytics, insurance data analysis, claims operations, actuarial support, underwriting analytics, TPA oversight, or related insurance analytics roles.
Experience working within Azure Databricks (preferred), using notebooks to analyse and transform data, and leveraging Azure data services such as Azure SQL, Data Lake Storage, and cloud-based data platforms.
Experience extracting and analysing data from systems or reporting platforms, including Lloyd’s/delegated authority bordereaux.
Demonstrated ability to analyse complex datasets and present findings in a clear, concise, business-relevant manner.


Preferred Experience


Prior experience with a TPA, MGA, MGU, insurance carrier, or reinsurer within a delegated authority business.
Experience working with Actuarial and Underwriting teams.
Familiarity with claims bordereaux, delegated authority reporting, capacity partner reporting, or reinsurance reporting.
Experience with Databricks, Synapse, or similar analytics tools.
Understanding of claims leakage, severity management, reserve adequacy, litigation trends, fraud indicators, subrogation, and vendor performance.

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
Commercial Data Analyst

£45,000 – £55,000 | London | Hybrid, 3 days a week on site




Fancy a Data Analyst role where you're actually in the room when the decisions get made?




We're working with a fast-growing luxury fashion and eCommerce group that's investing heavily in its next stage of growth. At the centre of the business is a membership-led digital platform with a growing customer base and a lot of rich behavioural data to dig into.




They're now building out the data, tech and commercial infrastructure to support that growth, and are looking for a Commercial Data Analyst to be one of the foundational people on that journey.

This isn't a dashboards-into-the-void kind of role. You'll be working directly with senior commercial leadership, using data to understand customer behaviour, spot trends, and answer the questions that are actually driving growth across the business.




What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of analysis across customer, membership, trading and operational performance, including:

Using SQL to interrogate data across multiple systems and datasets
Turning broad commercial questions into clear, useful analysis
Spotting trends and opportunities worth digging into further
Building reporting and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar
Presenting findings in a way that lands with commercial and senior stakeholders
Helping define and measure the KPIs that matter as the business scales
Working between Commercial and Technology as the business develops its central data warehouse
Supporting data quality, accuracy and reporting logic as that environment evolves




You won't be expected to architect or build the data warehouse, there's already technical ownership in place. Your job is making sure the data coming out of it is accurate, useful, and able to support real commercial decisions.




What we're looking for

Strong SQL skills and confidence working independently with data
Previous experience working with a data warehouse
Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Looker
Strong reporting and trend-analysis experience
The ability to explain data clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders
Commercial curiosity, and the confidence to look beyond the original question




Experience in eCommerce, consumer, subscription, membership, marketplace or app-led businesses would be particularly relevant but we're far more interested in how you think than whether you've used the exact same tech stack before.




Why consider it

This is a newly created role with genuine visibility and room to grow. You'll work closely with the senior leader responsible for Commercial Finance, Strategy and Growth, with regular exposure to the wider leadership team.




You'll also be joining at a point where the group is actively improving how it uses data, consolidating reporting, and building the foundations for its next phase of growth. For someone currently sat in a larger analytics team, this could be your chance to:




Take much broader ownership of your analysis
Work directly with senior decision-makers
See the commercial impact of the insights you produce
Help shape a developing data function
Build towards Senior, Manager and potentially broader Data & Analytics leadership as the business scales




Package

£45,000 – £55,000
Hybrid, 3 days a week in the London office
Private medical cover
Staff discount
Further benefits currently being introduced




If you're technically strong but want your next move to bring more commercial exposure, ownership and progression, get in touch.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Marketing
Description:
At SheMed, our mission is to revolutionise women’s health by providing accessible and personalised solutions tailored specifically for women. We are a startup consisting of enthusiastic people who are committed to empowering women with the knowledge and tools they need to take control of their health and well-being.

SheMed is an innovative and advanced weight loss programme that is groundbreaking in the world of women’s health. We have an unwavering dedication to quality care, and strive to create a supportive and compassionate community where every woman can thrive and achieve optimal health. In doing so, we believe SheMed will be a strong force in closing the women’s health gap.

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded Senior Data Analyst, Marketing to become a key partner to the marketing team at SheMed.

This role will be embedded within marketing, helping the team make smarter, faster, data-led decisions across acquisition, retention, customer journeys, and campaign performance. You will drive the measurement of key growth channels, including Meta, Google, and influencer partnerships, and provide clear insight into what is working, what is not, and where we should focus next.

You will play a critical role in connecting marketing behaviour with wider business performance, including subscription metrics, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and retention.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent commercial judgement and communication skills. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, but equally confident translating your analysis into clear, non-technical narratives for senior leadership.




Please note: This is an office-based role, Monday to Friday, 9am – 6pm. We are based in Euston, London.




What You’ll Work On

Own marketing performance measurement across channels including Meta, Google, paid social, affiliates, and influencer partnerships.
Develop attribution frameworks to evaluate acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue performance.
Partner with marketing teams to optimise campaigns, audience targeting, creative performance, and budget allocation.
Analyse the end-to-end customer journey to identify drop-off points, behavioural trends, and growth opportunities.
Deliver insights to improve conversion, onboarding, CRM, lifecycle communications, retention, and customer value.
Own reporting and analysis for key subscription KPIs including CAC, LTV, payback period, churn, retention, conversion rate, subscription growth, and channel ROI.
Apply advanced analytics using SQL, Python, or R for cohort analysis, forecasting, predictive modelling, and Marketing Mix Modelling.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Tableau to support data-driven decision-making.
Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Use SQL and dbt to develop trusted, scalable data models and analytics infrastructure.
Collaborate with data, marketing, product, medical, finance, and leadership teams to align insights with business priorities.

Title: Growth Data Analyst
Description:
Did you see one of our viral campaigns, like findmohamedawife.com? Or maybe you know one of the 800,000 couples who met through Muzz? Whatever brought you here, now’s the perfect time to join a team on its way to becoming the first billion-dollar Muslim app.




We're looking for a Growth Data Analyst to join our dynamic Data team and help us make better decisions about how we grow Muzz around the world.




You'll be the analytical partner to our Growth team, owning measurement across global marketing activity and turning data into insights that help us acquire, activate, retain and monetise more users.




This isn't a role where you'll simply build dashboards and wait for someone to ask for a report. You'll work closely with Growth, Product and Data teams to understand what's happening, figure out why and identify what we should do next.




If you enjoy solving complex problems, explaining data in simple terms and finding opportunities hidden in the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.




Day to day

Own measurement across Muzz's global marketing activities and assess how effectively our marketing investments drive growth.
Build and maintain dashboards that give Marketing teams visibility of their KPIs and enable self-service reporting.
Analyse marketing performance across channels, markets and campaigns to identify growth opportunities.
Work closely with regional Brand, Social Media and Events teams to turn data and insights into better marketing strategies.
Investigate new and emerging marketing channels and assess their potential to drive incremental growth.
Own and prioritise ad hoc analytical requests from Marketing Specialists across our global markets.
Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations that help teams make better, data-led decisions.
Present findings and insights to non-technical stakeholders in a simple and actionable way.
Train and support business users so they can get the most out of our BI tools and become more self-sufficient with data.
Work with Product Analysts and Product teams to identify opportunities to use product features and data to improve personalised marketing.
Analyse opportunities to improve activation, retention and monetisation through better marketing and product collaboration.
Partner with Data Engineers to improve data models and ensure they can support multiple analytical and business needs.
Explore new datasets, tools and analytical approaches that can help Muzz better understand its users and growth opportunities.
Continuously improve how Marketing measures performance, reports results and uses data to make decisions.




What we’re looking for

3+ years of experience in data analytics, growth analytics, marketing analytics or a related field.
Strong SQL skills, with experience writing efficient, scalable and maintainable queries.
Experience building and maintaining BI dashboards, data models, searches and views.
Strong understanding of marketing measurement and performance, including acquisition, campaign performance and growth metrics.
Experience working with data-focused marketing teams and translating marketing questions into meaningful analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex questions and turn findings into clear recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to explain complex data and insights to non-technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work closely with Marketing, Product, Data and regional teams around the world.
Highly organised and able to prioritise multiple requests while balancing urgent business needs with longer-term analytical projects.
A commercial and growth mindset, with a genuine interest in understanding how data can unlock new opportunities for the business.
Comfortable working independently and proactively identifying questions that the business should be asking, rather than only answering questions you're given.
Experience collaborating with Data Engineers to design and improve data models that can support multiple business needs.




Must-Haves

Strong SQL & data skills - You can confidently write, optimise and maintain SQL queries and work with data models to answer complex business questions.
Marketing & growth analytics - You understand how marketing works and can connect metrics, campaigns and channels to meaningful business outcomes.
Analytical storytelling - You can turn complex analysis into a clear story, communicate insights to non-technical audiences and make recommendations that people can act on.
Ownership & prioritisation - You're organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple requests, prioritising competing needs and independently finding opportunities to improve how the business uses data.




Nice to have

Experience with Google BigQuery.
Experience with Mobile Measurement Platforms such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Experience with dbt.




Why join Muzz?

We’re a profitable Consumer Tech startup, backed by Y Combinator (S17) and based in London. Join our fast growing team and work on an amazing product that’s changing the world.

A great product - We’re the leading app in this space with over 10 million members worldwide and counting!
Level up quickly - Work with talented, generous people on the kinds of challenges you’ll be proud to share.
A diverse team - We have people from all walks of life all adding their unique perspective. Muslims and non-Muslims, cat lovers and dog lovers. Everyone is welcome!
Meaningful equity - We’re all working together to succeed and everyone on the team gets a slice of the pie.
A hackathon every quarter - We value curiosity and building something wacky (but useful!). Every quarter we organise into random teams and together we build, code, and prototype. Prizes and dinner complete the day!
International travel - We fly the whole team to somewhere amazing twice a year to connect and have fun.
Regular socials - Mini golf, hikes, super competitive Catan nights - we’ve done it all. Maybe you’ll be at the next social?
Generous Holiday / PTO - All full-time members get at least 33 days of holiday, regardless of where they live.




Interview Process

Step 1. Submit your CV
Step 2. An initial video call
Step 3. Complete a technical exercise
Step 4. Interview (in person or remote)
Step 5. Receive an offer!

Senior BI Analyst – Core BI delivery focused on requirements, KPI definition, analysis, and Power BI reporting using curated datasets
Senior BI Specialist – End‑to‑end delivery specialists combining advanced Power BI development with strong data‑engineering capability, owning solutions from discovery through build, validation, and rollout
Senior Data Foundation Analyst – Data‑engineering–focused role responsible for building, enriching, and governing data pipelines and datasets that enable downstream BI and analytics

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions

Apply strong communication, influence, and strategic thinking to shape analytics solutions and drive business decisions
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Oversee and support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Assist the business in the ideation of new analytics initiatives ranging from descriptive, diagnostic, predictive to prescriptive
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
Retrieve, integrate, and transform data from multiple systems using SQL, Python, and other scripting languages


What You Will Bring


3-5 years of relevant experience and a master’s degree in related field of study, or an equivalent combination of bachelor’s degree and extensive related experience
Strong experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualization tools (Power BI) with demonstrated experience at creating interactive dashboards

26WD99647, Senior Data Analyst

Position Overview 

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join the Strategic Data & Research team in our Go-To-Market Data Intelligence team. The GDI team is chartered with delivering accurate foundational data and customer intelligence to inform go-to-market (GTM) teams’ engagement across the customer lifecycle.

Data Analysts play a critical role in shaping GTM focus areas by uncovering insights, influencing business decisions, and partnering across functions to deliver customer intelligence used throughout the customer lifecycle.

We are open to remote candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities 


Own analytics projects from problem definition through delivery, identifying opportunities to refine the scope as new insights emerge
Drive investigative analyses, using business context and data to determine the next questions worth answering rather than simply executing predefined requests
Collaborate with Program Managers to explore new project ideas or enhancements 
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches that drive actionable decisions
Partner with Data Scientists to identify areas of improvement for Data Science models  
Work with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to operationalize our customer intelligence and make it accessible to the business
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear, actionable data storytelling
Build scalable reporting to measure progress in key initiatives 
Develop deep expertise in Autodesk’s customer and go-to-market data ecosystem
Work as an individual contributor with opportunities for leadership as we grow the team


Minimum Qualifications 


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or Business Analytics) or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
4+ years in an Analyst role 
Strong SQL coding skills and comfortable using it everyday 
Experience with Snowflake
Experience working in Python or R 
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) to accelerate data work, automate repetitive tasks, and improve analytical productivity
Comfortable with presenting data and storytelling using a variety of tools, ranging from PowerPoint to Power BI to Python


Preferred Qualifications 


Familiarity with Salesforce & Salesforce data objects
Familiarity with Data Science concepts 
Experience working in Git 
Experience working with DBT
Experience with Looker


The Ideal Candidate


Tells compelling stories using data – you weave together a narrative of what is happening in the business based on your analysis to help drive business decisions
Communicates effectively with both technical stakeholders and non-technical stakeholders 
Demonstrates intellectual curiosity by challenging assumptions, asking follow-up questions, and uncovering insights beyond the original request
Independently manages multiple workstreams while proactively communicating progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to stakeholders
Has a strong attention to detail and care deeply about data quality 
Proactively reaches out to stakeholders to understand the business use case better
Enjoys collaborating with team members to drive impact 


26WD99647, Analyste de données senior

Aperçu du Poste 

Autodesk recherche un analyste de données senior expérimenté pour rejoindre l’équipe « Strategic Data & Research » au sein de notre équipe « Go-To-Market Data Intelligence » (GDI). L’équipe GDI a pour mission de fournir des données de base précises et des informations sur les clients afin d’étayer l’action des équipes de commercialisation (GTM) tout au long du cycle de vie du client.

Les analystes de données jouent un rôle essentiel dans la définition des axes prioritaires de la stratégie de commercialisation (GTM) en mettant en évidence des informations pertinentes, en influençant les décisions commerciales et en collaborant avec les différentes fonctions pour fournir des informations clients utilisées tout au long du cycle de vie du client.

Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance basées au Canada.

Responsabilités 


Gérer des projets d’analyse de A à Z, de la définition du problème à la livraison, en identifiant les opportunités d’affiner le périmètre à mesure que de nouvelles informations émergent
Mener des analyses exploratoires, en s’appuyant sur le contexte métier et les données pour déterminer les prochaines questions auxquelles il convient de répondre, plutôt que de se contenter d’exécuter des demandes prédéfinies
Collaborer avec les chefs de projet pour explorer de nouvelles idées de projets ou des améliorations
Traduire des questions métier ambiguës en approches analytiques structurées qui conduisent à des décisions exploitables
Collaborer avec les data scientists pour identifier les axes d’amélioration des modèles de science des données
Travailler avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données et de Business Intelligence pour opérationnaliser nos informations clients et les rendre accessibles à l’entreprise
Présenter les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes, en influençant les décisions grâce à une présentation claire et exploitable des données
Mettre en place un système de reporting évolutif pour mesurer les progrès des initiatives clés
Développer une expertise approfondie de l’écosystème de données clients et de stratégie de commercialisation d’Autodesk
Travailler en tant que collaborateur autonome avec des opportunités d’évoluer vers des fonctions de direction à mesure que l’équipe s’agrandit


Qualifications Minimales 


Licence dans un domaine quantitatif (par exemple, statistiques, mathématiques, informatique, économie, science des données ou analyse de données d’entreprise) ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience professionnelle pertinente.
Au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans un poste d’analyste 
Solides compétences en codage SQL et aisance dans son utilisation quotidienne
Expérience avec Snowflake
Expérience de travail avec Python ou R 
Maîtrise des outils de développement assistés par l’IA (par exemple, Claude Code ou équivalent) pour accélérer le traitement des données, automatiser les tâches répétitives et améliorer la productivité analytique
Aisance dans la présentation des données et la narration à l’aide de divers outils, allant de PowerPoint à Power BI en passant par Python


Qualifications Souhaitées


Connaissance de Salesforce et des objets de données Salesforce
Connaissance des concepts de science des données 
Expérience de travail avec Git
Expérience de travail avec DBT
Expérience avec Looker


Le Candidat Idéal


Raconte des histoires captivantes à partir des données – vous tissez un récit de ce qui se passe dans l’entreprise en vous appuyant sur vos analyses afin de contribuer à orienter les décisions stratégiques
Communique efficacement tant avec les parties prenantes techniques que non techniques
Fait preuve de curiosité intellectuelle en remettant en question les hypothèses, en posant des questions complémentaires et en mettant au jour des informations allant au-delà de la demande initiale
Gère de manière autonome plusieurs axes de travail tout en communiquant de manière proactive sur l’avancement, les risques, les compromis et les recommandations aux parties prenantes
Fait preuve d’un grand souci du détail et accorde une grande importance à la qualité des données
Prend proactivement contact avec les parties prenantes pour mieux comprendre le cas d’utilisation métier
Aime collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe pour générer un impact

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.

Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool

Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows

Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-focused Senior Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations. Reporting to the Head of Lead Management, this role will be responsible for delivering insights that optimize sales performance, improve customer retention, and support new market expansion initiatives through the transfer of operational knowledge and best practices. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for key sales metrics
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and sales strategy initiatives
Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and business process

Analyze customer and policyholder behavior to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report on key post-sales metrics, including retention, service levels, and customer experience.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.




3. New Market Expansion & Knowledge Transfer (20%)

Support the organization's expansion into new markets by documenting and transferring key operational, sales, lead management, and customer service learnings from existing business operations.
Partner with stakeholders to capture best practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and performance insights that can be leveraged in future markets.
Develop and maintain knowledge repositories, documentation, and reporting standards to support successful market launches.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful sales, lead management, and customer retention strategies across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.
Track and report on key readiness milestones and business learnings throughout implementation programs.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!

Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset 



Let's talk perks!

Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops



If you'd like to see what the work environment at Genetec looks like, check out our corporate video: https://youtu.be/EupvfTWhRww?si=OuODVl0xkIFqdPZA



We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!



Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

Title: Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting
Description:
Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting




The University of Manitoba is a driving force of innovation, discovery and advancement. Our momentum is propelled by our campus community – UM faculty, staff and students whose determination and curiosity shape our world for the better. Our teaching, learning and work environment is uniquely strengthened and enriched by Indigenous perspectives. With two main campuses in Winnipeg, satellite campuses throughout Manitoba, and world-wide research, UM’s impact is global.




Discover outstanding employee benefits, experience world-class facilities and join a dynamic community that values reconciliation, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. We are one of Manitoba’s Top Employers and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. At the University of Manitoba, what inspires you can change everything.




The opportunity:




The Department of Family Medicine is seeking a Data Analyst, Program Evaluation & Reporting to support evidence-based decision-making, accreditation, workforce planning, and continuous quality improvement across its education and academic programs. The successful candidate will collect, validate, analyze, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from multiple sources, develop dashboards and standardized reports, support program evaluation and accreditation activities, and provide meaningful insights to departmental leadership and committees.




This role will also support data integration and reporting from systems such as Entrada, SurveyMonkey, Cognito Forms, and Excel; conduct audits and longitudinal analyses; track learner outcomes, teaching capacity, and workforce trends; and identify opportunities to improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting efficiency. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights while working collaboratively with academic and administrative stakeholders.




The qualifications and experience we’re looking for:




Undergraduate degree in data analytics, health informatics, statistics, public health, business analytics, or a related discipline required.
Master’s degree in a related discipline preferred.
Minimum three (3) years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or program evaluation.
Experience in a university, health system, or academic medical environment preferred.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Advanced data analysis and reporting skills is required.
Strong proficiency with Excel and survey platforms is required.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills and a thirst for learning. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong SAS skills needed currently. Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
What the Role Does

Turn data into better product decisions.

As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.

You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.




What You’ll Do

Collaborate with Product Owners to design and plan experiments, define requirements, assumptions, and limitations
Explore and analyze experiment data to understand customer behaviour, usage patterns, and performance drivers
Lead multiple analytical initiatives, using findings to recommend clear next steps and inform priorities
Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover customer behaviour trends, friction points, and growth opportunities
Use AI tools to research internal documentation and tools, support SQL and code development, and review analytical work efficiently
Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality
Translate business questions into measurable metrics
Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps
Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement
Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis
Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches

What You Bring

Post-secondary education in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or other related programs
3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science
Strong statistical judgment, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power considerations, and the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly
Solid understanding of statistics and experiment analysis
Proficiency in SQL, including writing efficient queries with joins, aggregations, and filtering logic

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
The Team

Here’s the honest version, because “A players” can smell spin a mile away: we’re building a team where the bar is high and rising, and you’d be one of the people who sets it. We hold a high standard for who we let through the door, and it climbs with every hire. Decisions get made on merit and evidence, and “because we’ve always done it that way” isn’t an answer anyone accepts. As an early, defining hire, you won’t just clear the bar; you’ll help raise it, and you’ll have a real hand in shaping how this team works and who joins it next. If you’ve ever been the only one in the building who cared this much about getting it right, this is your chance to stop being that person, and to help build the team you wish you’d had.




The Opportunity

Some people look at a dashboard and see a board. You see the one number that’s wrong and you can’t look away until you know why. Space Ops is a payments company that works with enormous volumes of data every day, and we’re looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about uncovering insights, identifying efficiencies, and solving problems. Success in this role requires more than technical skills. We’re looking for someone who notices the details others miss, challenges assumptions, and keeps digging until they understand exactly what’s behind the numbers. Meticulous, detail-obsessed, allergic to “good enough.” That’s the energy.




This is a role for a genuine data nerd, but not one who hides behind a dashboard. You’ll investigate anomalies, uncover root causes, validate ideas with data, and turn insights into actionable business recommendations. Working closely with management, you’ll solve complex problems, help shape reporting and analytics capabilities, and ensure customer and payment data is handled responsibly. If you’re excited by challenges that don’t come with an established playbook, you’ll thrive here.




We move fast and encourage people to use every modern tool available to work smarter and more efficiently. But tools don’t replace judgement. The value comes from asking the right questions, validating assumptions, investigating anomalies, and understanding the story behind the data. Above all, we use data to prove ideas, not just support them and to drive meaningful business decisions.




What You’ll Be Doing

Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Pull and analyze data, constantly. Write queries, build reports, and dig through our data to answer the question of the day (and the three questions it leads to).
Hunt for anomalies. Surface unusual patterns in the data and flag them before they become problems.
Find efficiencies; Identify where money, time, or processing is leaking, quantify the opportunity, and tell us not just what’s happening, but what we should do about it.
Get to the root cause. Don’t stop at the number; figure out what’s behind it. Reproduce issues, test things hands-on, and trace a problem from symptom to source until you know exactly what’s wrong and why.
Solve the unusual. Take on problems that don’t have an off-the-shelf answer, and work with management to invent one. Think outside the box, propose approaches nobody’s tried, and be ready to learn as you go.
Prove your ideas before we bet on them. Back test your hypotheses against historical data to see whether a solution would actually have performed. Bring us the evidence, not just the idea.
Translate numbers into decisions. Turn your analysis into clear, concise recommendations for leadership: no jargon, just the insight and the “so what.”




Reporting, Insights & Business Enablement

Recommend new reporting. Don’t just run the reports we have; tell us which ones we’re missing. Design and build dashboards and recurring reporting that give the team visibility they didn’t have before.
Spec what gets built. When something needs to be built by the team rather than by you alone, write clear, well-scoped PRDs that define what should be built: what it should show, why, and how it should work, so it gets built right the first time.
Be the go-to data person. Become the person teammates come to when they need a number, a trend, or a sanity check.




Operational Support & Data Stewardship

Jump on issues when they hit. Be part of an on-call rotation to help diagnose and resolve problems when they happen, including the occasional night or weekend. When things are down, every minute counts, and you’ll be one of the people we count on.
Handle data responsibly. Work with secured systems and personally identifiable (PII) customer data the right way, following access controls, privacy standards, and security best practices at every step.




What We’re Looking For

Passion is the price of entry here, but it isn’t a substitute for skill. The strongest candidates bring both. The first three below are non-negotiable; the rest matter, but you can grow into some of them.

Passion, first and foremost. You’re genuinely energized by finding efficiencies, improvements, and the story hidden in the data. This isn’t a box to check; it’s how you’re wired (Non-negotiable) .
A root-cause mindset. You’re not satisfied knowing that something’s wrong; you want to know why, and you’ll test, reproduce, and investigate until you do. (Non-negotiable.)
Strong SQL and real comfort working with large datasets. You can get your own answers without waiting on anyone. (Non-negotiable.)
An outside-the-box thinker who loves to learn. You’re energized by problems that don’t come with a known answer, you’re comfortable inventing your own approach, and you pick up new things fast.
Meticulous and detail-obsessed. You notice the small things others miss; you double-check your work, and a number that’s slightly off will bother you until it’s explained (Within reason: thorough, not paralyzed.). Chasing the last 0.3% is rewarding and exciting.
You use modern tools well and own the judgment. You reach for whatever helps you work faster and sharper, but you never outsource your thinking to a tool. You trust an output only as far as the foundation behind it holds up.
The ability to take a messy, open-ended question and turn it into a clear analysis with a recommendation attached.
A business brain, not just a data brain. You see how every number ties back to a business outcome: revenue, cost, risk, or the customer. You frame your findings around what they mean for the company, not just what they show.
You actually use the product space. You buy things online and pay attention to how checkout and payment experiences feel, so you understand the customer’s side of the data, not just the rows in a table.
Experience working with secured data and PII. You understand how to handle sensitive customer data responsibly. Access controls, data privacy, and security best practices are second nature to you.
Comfortable writing PRDs / requirements docs. You can clearly specify what a report or dashboard should do so a technical team can build it, defining scope, logic, and the “why” behind it.
Willing to be on-call. You’re okay with an on-call rotation and the occasional off-hours call when something needs diagnosing, and honestly, a little excited to be the one who fixes it.
Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain findings to someone who doesn’t live in the data.
Experience building reports and dashboards in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).
Solid grasp of spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets) for quick analysis and modeling.
Comfortable working on-site, collaborating shoulder-to-shoulder with the team and leadership.

You don’t need every bullet on this list. But if the first three don’t sound like you, this probably isn’t your role, and that’s okay.




Nice to have

• Experience in payments, fintech, banking, or e-commerce.

• Familiarity with Python or R for deeper analysis.

• Understanding of data privacy / security frameworks relevant to payments (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR, or similar).

• Experience setting up automated / recurring reporting from scratch.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do


Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We’re Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining,reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE?

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Canada without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
