Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.




We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Campus is situated within the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.




The Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies with locations in Canada, USA, France and the UK. CDL-Vancouver is anchored at the UBC Sauder School of Business, supporting and contributing to the entire west coast innovation ecosystem in Canada and in the US.CDL-Vancouver works directly with start-up companies within the Climate, Compute, Biomedical Engineering, and Advanced Therapies (stream info). Read more.




CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.




The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.




The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.




Work Performed

Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
Performs other related duties.




Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.




- Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own

- Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion




Preferred Qualifications

A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
Technical documentation skills.
The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.




Compensation Range

$6,143.67 - $8,830.25 CAD Monthly

The Compensation Range is the span between the minimum and maximum base salary for a position. The midpoint of the range is approximately halfway between the minimum and the maximum and represents an employee that possesses full job knowledge, qualifications and experience for the position. In the normal course, employees will be hired, transferred or promoted between the minimum and midpoint of the salary range for a job.




Posting End Date: September 22, 2026




Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.




Job End Date: Ongoing




Please note Applications will only be accepted via the hiring portal, please do not send over LinkedIn. We anticipate high volume of applicants for this role and only selected candidates will be contacted.

That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks

You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.

You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.

You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.

Training and development opportunities to grow your career.

Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition, The Company offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, wellness programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

Title: Data Analyst, Sr.
Description:
About The Company

Lookout is a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to delivering innovative solutions across various sectors, including cybersecurity, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms. Committed to excellence and continuous improvement, the company fosters a collaborative and dynamic work environment that encourages professional growth and innovation. With a focus on leveraging data-driven insights to inform strategic decisions, the organization prides itself on its cutting-edge technology stack, customer-centric approach, and commitment to integrity and transparency.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analyst will serve as the key driver of the company's reporting and analytics functions. As the sole Data Analyst within the organization, this role acts as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with cross-functional teams to transform complex data sets into actionable insights. The successful candidate will analyze various data sources, including business operations, customer behavior, mobile telemetry, and security events, to support strategic decision-making, measure product performance, and identify emerging trends. Additionally, this role involves contributing to financial reporting processes such as quarter-end closes, invoicing, and reconciliation activities. The ideal candidate will possess advanced SQL skills, excellent problem-solving abilities, and strong communication skills to effectively translate data findings into meaningful business recommendations.

Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or similar environments
Expert-level proficiency in SQL, with experience working with complex relational datasets
Experience with AWS Athena or similar cloud-based analytical query engines
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling principles
Advanced experience with Tableau or equivalent BI platforms
Proficiency in analyzing large-scale datasets in cloud environments
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data
Knowledge of data governance and data quality best practices
Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, automation, and data exploration preferred
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights clearly
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills
Ability to manage multiple projects with minimal supervision


Responsibilities


Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau
Analyze key business metrics such as revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, and product adoption
Evaluate mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, and feature usage data to inform product development
Monitor security event data to identify threats, trends, anomalies, and evaluate product effectiveness
Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security teams to address analytical needs
Define and track KPIs, monitor trends, and identify opportunities for operational and strategic improvements
Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop comprehensive reporting solutions
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all reports and analyses
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical processes
Continuously improve the company’s reporting and analytics capabilities, becoming a trusted internal partner


Benefits


Comprehensive healthcare benefits
Paid parental leave
Fitness reimbursement
Company match for charitable donations
Cell phone reimbursement
Work-from-home support
Anniversary awards
All-hands gatherings
Community groups and team-building activities
Paid time off and volunteer time off
Company holidays and global holiday shutdowns


Equal Opportunity

Lookout is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We believe in fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

As our next Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance & Operations will serve as the primary Power BI specialist supporting our Canadian operations and shared services functions. This role combines data analytics, reporting development, systems integration, and business partnership to improve decision-making across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and Leadership.

You will work with data from multiple ERP and business systems to develop scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, automate manual processes, and transform complex information into meaningful, actionable business insights. Support the development and maintenance of reporting governance practices and documentation.

Assist with the analysis of business performance, sales trends, operational metrics, and financial results.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning through reporting and analytical tools.
Translate complex business and technical data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Respond to ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For:

Experience: Three to five years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting Systems, or a related field.
Education: Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
Power BI Expertise: Advanced Power BI capabilities, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, and performance optimization.

Systems Integration: Experience integrating, transforming, and validating data from multiple business systems.
Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
ERP Experience: Experience with Oracle, CMS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Manufacturing Experience: Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is considered an asset.
Additional Technology Experience: Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Cognos, Python, or other analytical programming tools is considered an asset.
Emerging Analytics Tools: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, Copilot, machine learning concepts, or predictive analytics is considered an asset.
Analytical Strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights.
Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Demonstrated success translating business requirements into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Independence: Self-starter who can independently manage multiple priorities and projects.
Continuous Improvement: Passion for analytics, automation, technology, and process improvement.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while consistently delivering high-quality results

Johnson Electric offers talented people like you the opportunity to grow professionally and personally, surrounded by some of the most dedicated, innovative, and entrepreneurial colleagues you will find anywhere. Title: Data Analyst- Claims
Description:
Company: CGIC

Department: Claims

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.

We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Campus is situated within the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.

The Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies with locations in Canada, USA, France and the UK. CDL-Vancouver is anchored at the UBC Sauder School of Business, supporting and contributing to the entire west coast innovation ecosystem in Canada and in the US.CDL-Vancouver works directly with start-up companies within the Climate, Compute, Biomedical Engineering, and Advanced Therapies (stream info). Read more.

CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.

The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.

The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.

Organizational Status

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Works closely with the CDL Leadership team, Operations team, Partnerships team, and Venture Management team.

Work Performed


Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
Performs other related duties.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

Responsible for providing accurate, potentially sensitive, and confidential information to other members of the team. Must respect the confidentiality of information handled.

Failure to exercise appropriate judgment could put the department in violation of privacy laws, increase direct costs, contribute to lost opportunities, damage the reputation of the university, and potentially negatively impact relationships and philanthropic support.

Supervision Received

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Also takes direction from CDL’s Leadership team.

Supervision Given

None

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
Technical documentation skills.
The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.

HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

The Senior Data Analyst I, Product  within Mistplay's Data department will play a crucial role in enhancing Mistplay's business performance through insightful analysis and driving analytics strategy. Reporting to the Manager of Data Analytics & Experimentation, you will collaborate with Product & Lifecycle Managers to plan and analyze the results of A/B tests, and drive insights reporting in order to inform the release of new product features and engagement strategies.





What You'll Be Doing:







Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.








Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields








4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions








Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences








Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)








Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel








Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling








Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 








Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 








Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)







Bonus if you have:






A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.

BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields

Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)

A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.

Description:

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le bilinguisme français et anglais est un atout.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.

Échelle salariale prévue de : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

Le salaire du candidat retenu sera déterminé à la discrétion de Co-operators et variera selon plusieurs critères, notamment les conditions du marché local, la situation géographique et des facteurs liés à l'emploi tels que les connaissances, les compétences, les qualifications, l'expérience et la formation.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.


For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Title: Data Analyst – Center of Excellence & Data Analytics
Description:
What You’ll Do


Collaborate with audit teams to understand audit objectives, business processes, data requirements, and reporting needs.
Design and execute data analytics procedures for audit engagements, including control testing, population analysis, exception reporting, and pattern identification.
Summarize analytical results into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Extract, clean, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Python, or Excel to support audit testing and risk assessments.
Identify anomalies, trends, outliers, and risk indicators through advanced data analysis.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI.
Build reusable analytics scripts, templates, and reporting assets to improve efficiency and consistency.
Use Power Automate to support workflow automation, reporting processes, and repeatable analytics activities.
Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit’s data analytics capabilities, tools, and methodologies.
Leverage tools such as KNIME or similar platforms where applicable to support data preparation, analytics workflows, and automation.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, audit, risk management, or a related field.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, etc.
Experience with KNIME, Azure Synapse, Copilot Studio is an asset.
Strong data visualization skills, with the ability to present analytical findings in a clear and business-relevant manner.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to work with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of audit, risk management, internal controls, and business processes.


Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid: In-office 4 days a week)

We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Broadband Salary Range: $53,000 – $88,000 CAD.

Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. For critical roles, the compensation offering will be reviewed to ensure alignment with market rate and conditions and the unique value you bring to the role.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization.

We may use artificial intelligence tools as part of our recruitment process to assist in the initial screening of resumes. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters.

About Us

Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. We offer competitive salaries and wages to CTC employees, as well as store discounts, supported learning through our Triangle Learning Academy, Canadian Tire Profit Sharing, and retirement and savings programs for eligible employees. As part of our enhanced flex benefits program, we offer mental health benefits in the amount of $5,000 per year for benefits-eligible employees and their families, including total well-being, and mental health tools and resources for all employees. Join us in helping to make life in Canada better through living and working our Core Values: we are innovators and entrepreneurs at our core, outcomes drive us, inclusion is a must, we are stronger together and we take personal responsibility. It is an especially exciting time to join CTC and its family of companies where career opportunities are wide-ranging! Join us, where there's a place for you here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. We believe in building an organizational culture where people are consistently treated with dignity while respecting individual religion, nationality, gender, race, age, perceived ability, spoken language, sexual orientation, and identification. We are united in our purpose of being here to help make life in Canada better.

Accommodations

We stand firm in our Core Value that inclusion is a must. We welcome and encourage candidates from equity-seeking groups such as people who identify as racialized, Indigenous, 2SLGBTQIA+, women, people with disabilities, and beyond. Should you require any accommodation in applying for this role, or throughout the interview process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to help meet your needs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Title: DevOps - Data Analyst
Description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Support the Data Operations team by developing reporting solutions, validating data quality, documenting business definitions, and maintaining governed data products. The Data Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps team to ensure trusted, consistent, and actionable reporting.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Analytics


Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and scorecards for management and executives
Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, budgets, and targets
Develop and maintain KPIs, measures, and visualizations aligned to business requirements.


Data Quality & Validation


Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile metrics across systems.
Support resolution of data quality issues by identifying root causes and documenting findings.
Validate reporting accuracy following deployments, system changes, or business logic updates.


Business Engagement & Requirements


Translate business questions into reporting and analytics solutions.
Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.


Governance & Documentation


Maintain KPI definitions, business glossaries, and reporting documentation.
Assist in semantic model and report certification activities.
Ensure reporting assets align with established governance standards and business definitions.


Data Product & Semantic Model Support


Support development and maintenance of reusable semantic models and views.
Support users in discovering and effectively utilizing certified reports and datasets.


Continuous Improvement


Recommend improvements to reporting, data quality, and analytics processes.
Contribute to ongoing DataOps initiatives that improve efficiency, governance, and data accessibility.


Experience


1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with multiple business systems and datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.


Requirements


Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, data analysis).
Power BI report development and dashboard design.
Ability to trace data lineage from source systems through transformations to reporting outputs.
Basic to intermediate DAX development.
Basic SQL querying and data validation.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills


Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Semantic Models, Dataflows Gen2).
Experience with HubSpot CRM.
Experience with NetSuite ERP and revenue-related datasets.
Azure DevOps or similar work management platform.
PySpark, Python, or notebook development experience.
Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
Advanced DAX development and performance optimization.
Experience supporting or developing semantic models.


Revenue Analytics & Business Performance


Experience supporting revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing analytics functions.
Understanding of recurring revenue business models.


Governance & DataOps


Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metric glossaries, or metadata repositories.
Experience supporting certification, quality assurance, or report validation processes.
Understanding of modern analytics architectures, including data warehousing, lakehouse, and medallion architecture concepts.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling concepts including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.


What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes:


Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.


Our Equal Opportunity Commitment


F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.
For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required.

Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Entreprise: CAGC

Service: Sinistres

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le bilinguisme français et anglais est un atout.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
