Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Description:
Senior Insights Analyst




About Us

At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.




OUR VALUES

Everything we do is guided by our five shared commitments:

Value Every Voice - We put people first.
Act with Integrity - We do what’s right.
Explore Beyond Boundaries - We’re driven by curiosity.
Own the Outcome - We take responsibility for our decisions.
Succeed Together - We’ve got each other’s backs.




Position Summary

The Senior Insights Analyst is responsible for supporting TTC's global contact centre reporting, analytics, and operational insight capabilities across sales, service, workforce, and omnichannel performance.This role combines technical expertise with business-facing analytical support, partnering closely with operational leadership and key stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions, actionable insights, and data-driven decision support.

The successful candidate will possess strong experience working with Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, and large operational datasets, while demonstrating the ability to communicate meaningful business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze global contact centre performance across sales, service, customer experience, productivity, and operational KPIs.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, executive reporting, and performance reviews.
Support forecasting, incentive reporting, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key performance drivers across regions and teams.

Technical Development & Data Management

Develop and maintain SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions within Snowflake and Power BI.
Manage and integrate data from contact centre, CRM, workforce, and sales platforms.
Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.
Ensure data quality, KPI consistency, and reporting governance standards are maintained.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Present reporting outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Serve as a trusted resource for KPI definitions, reporting methodology, and operational analytics.

Process Improvement & Transformation

Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.
Support transformation initiatives, including CCaaS, AI, and reporting modernization programs.
Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.




About You

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.


_________________________________

Your Mission

As part of the Business Intelligence & Performance team, you will play a key role in analyzing and monitoring the company’s business and digital performance. Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence processes in a collaborative and omnichannel environment.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting


Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support operational priorities and strategic business decisions.
Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reports, KPIs, and dashboards.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support business growth and operational efficiency.


Digital Performance Analysis


Monitor and analyze digital performance across key channels, including website, media, SEO, CRM, and other digital touchpoints.
Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.
Ensure the quality and accuracy of tracking and measurement processes in collaboration with technical teams and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.


Data Management & Continuous Improvement


Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret data using tools such as BigQuery and SQL.
Maintain and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and recurring reporting processes.
Support day-to-day reporting and analytical needs across multiple business functions.
Contribute to omnichannel, business intelligence, and data transformation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, automation, and overall analytical capabilities.


Profile

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and automation.
Good knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms.


Personal Competencies


Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Ability to influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.


Assets


Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, travel, hospitality, retail, or omnichannel business environments.
Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Company: CGIC

Department: Claims

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact


Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.



To Join Our Team


You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks



How You Will Succeed


You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.



What You Need To Know


You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.



What’s in it for you?


Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.



Salary information

Expected Salary range : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;

Formation et expérience

  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Finance & Operations
Description:
Join Our Team as a Business Intelligence Analyst - Finance & Operations at Johnson Electric!




Location: Mississauga, ON (100% onsite)

Salary Range: $80-95K CAD annually

Vacancy Type: Existing position

Schedule: Straight Day Shift

Travel: Some Travel Between Local Sites




As our next Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance & Operations will serve as the primary Power BI specialist supporting our Canadian operations and shared services functions. This role combines data analytics, reporting development, systems integration, and business partnership to improve decision-making across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and Leadership.

You will work with data from multiple ERP and business systems to develop scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, automate manual processes, and transform complex information into meaningful, actionable business insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong Business Intelligence professional who is passionate about analytics, automation, and continuous improvement.




Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Employee Well-being: Focus on employee health and well-being through various wellness programs and initiatives.
Inclusive Workplace: Join an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are valued and respected.
Technological Leadership: Be part of a company that drives technological advancement and continuous innovation.
High-Impact Opportunity: Help shape the digital future of a growing manufacturing organization while gaining visibility with senior leadership.
Innovation and Growth: Explore new opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital reporting solutions.




What You’ll Be Doing:

Serve as the primary Power BI subject matter expert for Canadian operations and shared services.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, KPI scorecards, and executive-level performance reporting tools.
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query best practices.
Enhance existing reporting solutions and identify opportunities to improve reporting effectiveness, accessibility, and user experience.
Create automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the availability of business information.
Monitor and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, and reporting processes.
Maintain reporting documentation, report inventories, and user guides.
Identify opportunities to digitalize and automate manual business and reporting processes.
Use Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, and other analytics tools to improve business visibility and operational efficiency.
Extract, transform, and validate data from Oracle, CMS, and other business systems.
Develop and troubleshoot SQL queries and data-extraction processes supporting reporting and analytical requirements.
Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to improve system connectivity, reporting automation, and data accessibility.
Evaluate new technologies and analytics tools that enhance reporting, automation, and decision-making.
Support adoption of reporting solutions through training, documentation, and ongoing user support.
Improve data integrity across ERP, reporting, and business systems through validation, standardization, and process improvements.
Maintain data mappings, reporting structures, and master-data relationships used within Power BI environments.
Partner with Finance, Operations, and IT to establish consistent KPI definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.
Help ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and transparency across multiple plants and business functions.
Support the development and maintenance of reporting governance practices and documentation.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting requirements through automated reporting solutions and data analytics.
Work with business unit controllers, operations leaders, and management teams to understand reporting needs and business challenges.
Assist with the analysis of business performance, sales trends, operational metrics, and financial results.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning through reporting and analytical tools.
Translate complex business and technical data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Respond to ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For:

Experience: Three to five years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting Systems, or a related field.
Education: Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
Power BI Expertise: Advanced Power BI capabilities, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, and performance optimization.
SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills with the ability to develop and troubleshoot complex queries.
Systems Integration: Experience integrating, transforming, and validating data from multiple business systems.
Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
ERP Experience: Experience with Oracle, CMS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Manufacturing Experience: Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is considered an asset.
Additional Technology Experience: Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Cognos, Python, or other analytical programming tools is considered an asset.
Emerging Analytics Tools: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, Copilot, machine learning concepts, or predictive analytics is considered an asset.
Analytical Strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights.
Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Demonstrated success translating business requirements into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Independence: Self-starter who can independently manage multiple priorities and projects.
Continuous Improvement: Passion for analytics, automation, technology, and process improvement.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while consistently delivering high-quality results




What We Offer:

Johnson Electric offers talented people like you the opportunity to grow professionally and personally, surrounded by some of the most dedicated, innovative, and entrepreneurial colleagues you will find anywhere. Of course, we offer competitive pay and benefits, and far more than that, we offer you a culture driven by our values and designed to ensure that our most important asset—our people—can flourish.

Title: Data Analyst, Power BI
Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.


Interpersonal Skills


Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.




We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Campus is situated within the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.




The Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies with locations in Canada, USA, France and the UK. CDL-Vancouver is anchored at the UBC Sauder School of Business, supporting and contributing to the entire west coast innovation ecosystem in Canada and in the US.CDL-Vancouver works directly with start-up companies within the Climate, Compute, Biomedical Engineering, and Advanced Therapies (stream info). Read more.




CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.




The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.




The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.




Work Performed

Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
Performs other related duties.




Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.




- Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own

- Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion




Preferred Qualifications

A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
Technical documentation skills.
The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.




Compensation Range

$6,143.67 - $8,830.25 CAD Monthly

The midpoint of the range is approximately halfway between the minimum and the maximum and represents an employee that possesses full job knowledge, qualifications and experience for the position. In the normal course, employees will be hired, transferred or promoted between the minimum and midpoint of the salary range for a job.

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.




Job End Date: Ongoing

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.

We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Campus is situated within the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.

The Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies with locations in Canada, USA, France and the UK. CDL-Vancouver is anchored at the UBC Sauder School of Business, supporting and contributing to the entire west coast innovation ecosystem in Canada and in the US.CDL-Vancouver works directly with start-up companies within the Climate, Compute, Biomedical Engineering, and Advanced Therapies (stream info). Read more.

CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.

The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.

The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.

Organizational Status

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Works closely with the CDL Leadership team, Operations team, Partnerships team, and Venture Management team.

Work Performed


Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
Performs other related duties.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

Responsible for providing accurate, potentially sensitive, and confidential information to other members of the team. Must respect the confidentiality of information handled.

Failure to exercise appropriate judgment could put the department in violation of privacy laws, increase direct costs, contribute to lost opportunities, damage the reputation of the university, and potentially negatively impact relationships and philanthropic support.

Supervision Received

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Also takes direction from CDL’s Leadership team.

Supervision Given

None

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications


A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.

The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.

CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.

The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.

The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.

Organizational Status

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Works closely with the CDL Leadership team, Operations team, Partnerships team, and Venture Management team.

Work Performed

  • Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
  • Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
  • Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
  • Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
  • Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
  • Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
  • Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
  • In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
  • Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
  • Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
  • Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
  • Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
  • Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
  • Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
  • Performs other related duties.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

Responsible for providing accurate, potentially sensitive, and confidential information to other members of the team. Must respect the confidentiality of information handled.

Failure to exercise appropriate judgment could put the department in violation of privacy laws, increase direct costs, contribute to lost opportunities, damage the reputation of the university, and potentially negatively impact relationships and philanthropic support.

Supervision Received

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Also takes direction from CDL’s Leadership team.

Supervision Given

None

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

  • A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
  • Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
  • Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
  • Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
  • Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
  • Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
  • Technical documentation skills.
  • The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
  • Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.

Title: DevOps - Data Analyst
Description:

Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Support the Data Operations team by developing reporting solutions, validating data quality, documenting business definitions, and maintaining governed data products. The Data Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and the DataOps team to ensure trusted, consistent, and actionable reporting.

Responsibilities

Reporting & Analytics


Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards and scorecards for management and executives
Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, budgets, and targets
Develop and maintain KPIs, measures, and visualizations aligned to business requirements.


Data Quality & Validation


Investigate reporting discrepancies and reconcile metrics across systems.
Support resolution of data quality issues by identifying root causes and documenting findings.
Validate reporting accuracy following deployments, system changes, or business logic updates.


Business Engagement & Requirements


Translate business questions into reporting and analytics solutions.
Partner with business teams to understand operational processes, KPIs, and reporting needs.


Governance & Documentation


Maintain KPI definitions, business glossaries, and reporting documentation.
Assist in semantic model and report certification activities.
Ensure reporting assets align with established governance standards and business definitions.


Data Product & Semantic Model Support


Support development and maintenance of reusable semantic models and views.
Support users in discovering and effectively utilizing certified reports and datasets.


Continuous Improvement


Recommend improvements to reporting, data quality, and analytics processes.
Contribute to ongoing DataOps initiatives that improve efficiency, governance, and data accessibility.


Experience


1-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with multiple business systems and datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.


Requirements


Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, data analysis).
Power BI report development and dashboard design.
Ability to trace data lineage from source systems through transformations to reporting outputs.
Basic to intermediate DAX development.
Basic SQL querying and data validation.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills


Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Semantic Models, Dataflows Gen2).
Experience with HubSpot CRM.
Experience with NetSuite ERP and revenue-related datasets.
Azure DevOps or similar work management platform.
PySpark, Python, or notebook development experience.
Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
Advanced DAX development and performance optimization.
Experience supporting or developing semantic models.


Revenue Analytics & Business Performance


Experience supporting revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing analytics functions.
Understanding of recurring revenue business models.


Governance & DataOps


Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metric glossaries, or metadata repositories.
Experience supporting certification, quality assurance, or report validation processes.
Understanding of modern analytics architectures, including data warehousing, lakehouse, and medallion architecture concepts.
Working knowledge of dimensional modeling concepts including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.


What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes:


Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.


Our Equal Opportunity Commitment


F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.
For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required.

Title: Analyste de données
Description:
Entreprise: CAGC

Service: Sinistres

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le bilinguisme français et anglais est un atout.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.


Renseignements sur les salaires

Échelle salariale prévue de : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

Le salaire du candidat retenu sera déterminé à la discrétion de Co-operators et variera selon plusieurs critères, notamment les conditions du marché local, la situation géographique et des facteurs liés à l'emploi tels que les connaissances, les compétences, les qualifications, l'expérience et la formation.

Title: Data Analyst – Center of Excellence & Data Analytics
Description:
What You’ll Do


Collaborate with audit teams to understand audit objectives, business processes, data requirements, and reporting needs.
Design and execute data analytics procedures for audit engagements, including control testing, population analysis, exception reporting, and pattern identification.
Summarize analytical results into clear, concise insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Extract, clean, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Python, or Excel to support audit testing and risk assessments.
Identify anomalies, trends, outliers, and risk indicators through advanced data analysis.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI.
Build reusable analytics scripts, templates, and reporting assets to improve efficiency and consistency.
Use Power Automate to support workflow automation, reporting processes, and repeatable analytics activities.
Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit’s data analytics capabilities, tools, and methodologies.
Leverage tools such as KNIME or similar platforms where applicable to support data preparation, analytics workflows, and automation.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field.
3–5 years of experience in data analytics, audit, risk management, or a related field.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, etc.
Experience with KNIME, Azure Synapse, Copilot Studio is an asset.
Strong data visualization skills, with the ability to present analytical findings in a clear and business-relevant manner.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to work with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of audit, risk management, internal controls, and business processes.


Location: Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid: In-office 4 days a week)

We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Broadband Salary Range: $53,000 – $88,000 CAD.

Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. For critical roles, the compensation offering will be reviewed to ensure alignment with market rate and conditions and the unique value you bring to the role.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization.

We may use artificial intelligence tools as part of our recruitment process to assist in the initial screening of resumes. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters.

About Us

Reporting & Business Insights

Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

Permanent Full Time

We are looking for Senior Analysts to join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics & Reporting team. We are currently hiring for multiple Senior Data Analyst roles and are seeking candidates with experience across one or more of the following skill sets:

We’re hiring for experience in the following areas:


Senior BI Analyst – Core BI delivery focused on requirements, KPI definition, analysis, and Power BI reporting using curated datasets
Senior BI Specialist – End‑to‑end delivery specialists combining advanced Power BI development with strong data‑engineering capability, owning solutions from discovery through build, validation, and rollout
Senior Data Foundation Analyst – Data‑engineering–focused role responsible for building, enriching, and governing data pipelines and datasets that enable downstream BI and analytics


As a Senior Analyst you will join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the ideation, development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Apply strong communication, influence, and strategic thinking to shape analytics solutions and drive business decisions
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Oversee and support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Assist the business in the ideation of new analytics initiatives ranging from descriptive, diagnostic, predictive to prescriptive
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
Retrieve, integrate, and transform data from multiple systems using SQL, Python, and other scripting languages


What You Will Bring


3-5 years of relevant experience and a master’s degree in related field of study, or an equivalent combination of bachelor’s degree and extensive related experience
Strong experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualization tools (Power BI) with demonstrated experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) certification preferred
Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership
Strong analytical skills for problem solving and to monetize value for the organization
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction
Think outside the box and identify solutions to overcome obstacles
Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset
Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life.


The base salary for this position is between $80,400 - $130,400 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

26WD99647, Senior Data Analyst

Position Overview 

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join the Strategic Data & Research team in our Go-To-Market Data Intelligence team. The GDI team is chartered with delivering accurate foundational data and customer intelligence to inform go-to-market (GTM) teams’ engagement across the customer lifecycle.

Data Analysts play a critical role in shaping GTM focus areas by uncovering insights, influencing business decisions, and partnering across functions to deliver customer intelligence used throughout the customer lifecycle.

We are open to remote candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities 


Own analytics projects from problem definition through delivery, identifying opportunities to refine the scope as new insights emerge
Drive investigative analyses, using business context and data to determine the next questions worth answering rather than simply executing predefined requests
Collaborate with Program Managers to explore new project ideas or enhancements 
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches that drive actionable decisions
Partner with Data Scientists to identify areas of improvement for Data Science models  
Work with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence teams to operationalize our customer intelligence and make it accessible to the business
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear, actionable data storytelling
Build scalable reporting to measure progress in key initiatives 
Develop deep expertise in Autodesk’s customer and go-to-market data ecosystem
Work as an individual contributor with opportunities for leadership as we grow the team


Minimum Qualifications 


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or Business Analytics) or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
4+ years in an Analyst role 
Strong SQL coding skills and comfortable using it everyday 
Experience with Snowflake
Experience working in Python or R 
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) to accelerate data work, automate repetitive tasks, and improve analytical productivity
Comfortable with presenting data and storytelling using a variety of tools, ranging from PowerPoint to Power BI to Python


Preferred Qualifications 


Familiarity with Salesforce & Salesforce data objects
Familiarity with Data Science concepts 
Experience working in Git 
Experience working with DBT
Experience with Looker


The Ideal Candidate


Tells compelling stories using data – you weave together a narrative of what is happening in the business based on your analysis to help drive business decisions
Communicates effectively with both technical stakeholders and non-technical stakeholders 
Demonstrates intellectual curiosity by challenging assumptions, asking follow-up questions, and uncovering insights beyond the original request
Independently manages multiple workstreams while proactively communicating progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to stakeholders
Has a strong attention to detail and care deeply about data quality 
Proactively reaches out to stakeholders to understand the business use case better
Enjoys collaborating with team members to drive impact 


26WD99647, Analyste de données senior

Aperçu du Poste 

Autodesk recherche un analyste de données senior expérimenté pour rejoindre l’équipe « Strategic Data & Research » au sein de notre équipe « Go-To-Market Data Intelligence » (GDI). Permanent Full Time

As a Data Analyst, you will join Canada Life’s Canada Operations & Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Analyst, Data & Analytics supports decision making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will assist in modelling, analysing, and predicting business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements, collect, integrate, clean, explore, model, and analyze large datasets and visualize results and present to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Communicate effectively and demonstrate critical thinking and business acumen.
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner


What You Will Bring


Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life
1-3 years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is preferred
Demonstrated experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualisation tools (Power BI) with experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources, and to automate data pipelines
Proficiency in Power BI, Data Modelling, Power Query, and DAX
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Good knowledge in data analytics and statistical modelling
Strong communication and presentation skills
Proven ability to learn quickly and independently and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset


Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $109,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.
