Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $154,907 - $246,445

Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.

Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.

Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).

Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

As an analyst on the Health Marketing Analytics team, you will be part of a large analytics community and will be focused within the Client Experience Office (CXO), supporting the Client Experience team. This team is responsible for the design and execution of clear, compelling and caring client journeys, and using data and analytics to understand our clients and how our business can best support them in achieving their goals of lifetime financial security and living healthier lives. The Data Analyst will be helping the team by, but not limited to, mining data for business insights, analyzing and interpreting trends using statistical tools and techniques, reporting on business performance, and triaging code and data-related issues.

To be considered for this position, you are required to complete two steps in the application process. You will need to submit an online job application and complete an online assessment

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles, with strong attention to detail.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills and a thirst for learning. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong SAS skills needed currently. The transition to Python is underway as our data environment matures, and we’re looking for people who strive to continuously learn and try new tools and techniques.

What will you do?


Analytic work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations in order to solve business problems.
Deliver reports that are easy to interpret and rich with information
Support marketing campaigns, client targeting, campaign design and measurement, with strong attention to detail
Ability to draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations.
Work with manager to put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
Automate recurring tasks to free up team capacity. Find efficient ways of working
Work with stakeholders across Sun Life as a subject matter expert in client data
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities
An active contributing member to the analytics academy to help foster and grow the data science community at Sun Life


What you need to succeed:

2 + years experience working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating, and analyzing data, hypothesis testing, data modelling and data visualization)

2 + years experience with SQL, PySpark and other programming languages. Comfortable writing accurate, efficient, but complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources.


Experience with AWS Cloud Services (e.g. Glue, S3, Athena, Quick Suite)
Experience working with Tableau or other visualization tools
Experience using oral and written storytelling to share data driven insights in a clear, succinct manner.
Strong partnering approach with a commitment to meeting business partners' unique needs and expectations.
In-depth prioritization, planning, and change management skills to stay within time/scope of a task in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable learning new applications and processes quickly with minimal direction
Ability to document work.


What will be nice to have?


Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, forecasting etc.)
Experience in Salesforce
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience developing systems integrated with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Conversational AI
Advanced user of MS Excel and MS Access


What’s in it for you:


We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2026 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada.
We are thrilled to be recognized by Excellence Canada with their top-level certification, the Canada Order of Excellence for Mental Health at Work®, for prioritizing employee well-being, fostering a positive work culture, and achieving excellence in mental health.
Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical, and financial
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client need to choose where you work, at home or in the office


Unique requirements:


This role requires Reliability Security Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Title: Sr. BI and Insight Analyst
Description:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights. You will work across the full analytics lifecycle, partnering with business stakeholders to design, develop, and deliver scalable analytics and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision making across marketing, loyalty, merchandising, and promotional initiatives.

In This Role, You Will


Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements, translating business questions into scalable data and visualization solutions.
Identify, source, and integrate data from multiple enterprise systems to support business intelligence and analytical initiatives.
Design, develop, and maintain automated data pipelines and curated analytical datasets using SQL, Python/PySpark, and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Leverage modern analytics technologies such as Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and Power BI to build efficient, scalable, and maintainable reporting solutions.
Design and develop robust data models, semantic models, and reporting datasets that enable trusted, high-performing self-service analytics.
Apply data modeling best practices, including dimensional modeling, star schema design, fact and dimension structures, and measure governance to support enterprise reporting needs.
Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualization solutions that provide meaningful insights to business users and leadership teams.
Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, performance metrics, custom tooltips, drill-through experiences, and other interactive reporting features to enhance analytical capabilities.
Conduct analysis of campaign, customer, loyalty, sales, and promotional performance to identify trends, opportunities, and business drivers.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality by implementing validation processes, data governance standards, and reporting best practices.
Communicate complex analytical findings through clear visualizations, presentations, and business-focused storytelling.
Continuously improve reporting frameworks, data assets, and analytical processes through automation, optimization, and innovation.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics, performance measurement, or a related field.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

As our next Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance & Operations will serve as the primary Power BI specialist supporting our Canadian operations and shared services functions. This role combines data analytics, reporting development, systems integration, and business partnership to improve decision-making across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and Leadership.

You will work with data from multiple ERP and business systems to develop scalable reporting solutions, improve data quality, automate manual processes, and transform complex information into meaningful, actionable business insights. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong Business Intelligence professional who is passionate about analytics, automation, and continuous improvement.




Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Employee Well-being: Focus on employee health and well-being through various wellness programs and initiatives.
Inclusive Workplace: Join an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are valued and respected.
Technological Leadership: Be part of a company that drives technological advancement and continuous innovation.
High-Impact Opportunity: Help shape the digital future of a growing manufacturing organization while gaining visibility with senior leadership.
Innovation and Growth: Explore new opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital reporting solutions.




What You’ll Be Doing:

Serve as the primary Power BI subject matter expert for Canadian operations and shared services.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, data models, KPI scorecards, and executive-level performance reporting tools.
Develop and maintain data models, relationships, measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query best practices.
Enhance existing reporting solutions and identify opportunities to improve reporting effectiveness, accessibility, and user experience.
Create automated reporting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the availability of business information.
Monitor and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, and reporting processes.
Maintain reporting documentation, report inventories, and user guides.
Identify opportunities to digitalize and automate manual business and reporting processes.
Use Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Automate, and other analytics tools to improve business visibility and operational efficiency.

Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to improve system connectivity, reporting automation, and data accessibility.
Evaluate new technologies and analytics tools that enhance reporting, automation, and decision-making.
Support adoption of reporting solutions through training, documentation, and ongoing user support.
Improve data integrity across ERP, reporting, and business systems through validation, standardization, and process improvements.
Maintain data mappings, reporting structures, and master-data relationships used within Power BI environments.
Partner with Finance, Operations, and IT to establish consistent KPI definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.
Help ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and transparency across multiple plants and business functions.
Support the development and maintenance of reporting governance practices and documentation.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting requirements through automated reporting solutions and data analytics.
Work with business unit controllers, operations leaders, and management teams to understand reporting needs and business challenges.
Assist with the analysis of business performance, sales trends, operational metrics, and financial results.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning through reporting and analytical tools.
Translate complex business and technical data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Respond to ad hoc reporting and analytical requests from stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For:

Experience: Three to five years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting Systems, or a related field.
Education: Degree or diploma in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.

SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills with the ability to develop and troubleshoot complex queries.
Systems Integration: Experience integrating, transforming, and validating data from multiple business systems.
Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
ERP Experience: Experience with Oracle, CMS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Manufacturing Experience: Previous experience in a manufacturing environment is considered an asset.
Additional Technology Experience: Experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Cognos, Python, or other analytical programming tools is considered an asset.
Emerging Analytics Tools: Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools, Copilot, machine learning concepts, or predictive analytics is considered an asset.
Analytical Strength: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into actionable business insights.
Communication: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Demonstrated success translating business requirements into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Accuracy: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Independence: Self-starter who can independently manage multiple priorities and projects.
Continuous Improvement: Passion for analytics, automation, technology, and process improvement.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while consistently delivering high-quality results




What We Offer:

Johnson Electric offers talented people like you the opportunity to grow professionally and personally, surrounded by some of the most dedicated, innovative, and entrepreneurial colleagues you will find anywhere. Description:
Drug Intelligence is a leading Canadian health care data market research company with a 30+ year history. We specialize in providing relevant information, data and insights about serious and complex diseases from various therapeutic areas to our clients in the pharmaceutical industry.




As a Data Analyst at Drug Intelligence, you will be joining a dynamic team in a working environment that embraces high quality standards, initiative, creativity, and collaboration.




Important: to be considered for this position, in addition to the LinkedIn application we require candidates to fill out a 2, step, 20-min survey. You will automatically receive a link (by email) to complete the cognitive assessment (step 2) within 5 min of submitting the Predictive Index Assessment (step 1).

Link to survey: https://assessment.predictiveindex.com/bo/5PWK/Drug-Intelligence-Data-Analyst




Salary: $70,000-75,000 annually

 

Key Position Responsibilities:

 

Execute routine data processing tasks, including validation and transformation of data collected in a variety of formats into an analysis-ready format for other teams.
Extract, structure, and analyze relevant information from specific data sets, both recurring and on an ad-hoc basis, to meet client needs.
Own maintenance of existing data processes using Python and T-SQL (Azure): updating code to support new data elements and new analyses as requirements evolve and creating new data processing scripts as new projects arise.
Build and maintain data collection forms across multiple platforms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics).
Translate business and project requirements into data requirements with autonomy.
Become a subject matter expert on existing processes and work closely with data engineers to identify and help design solutions for process improvement and automation.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functionally on multiple simultaneous projects.




Desired Experience:

 

1-2 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or in a similar role, with strong foundational skills in Python and SQL.
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent preferred.
Strong knowledge of Python (including Pandas) and SQL, especially for data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data warehousing methodologies and ETL concepts.
Experience with Azure SQL Database or a similar cloud database platform.
Strong project management and time management skills.
Effective multidisciplinary problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with data collection forms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics) would be a plus.

Support KPI, operational, and management reporting.
Work with stakeholders to translate business and reporting requirements into reliable data solutions.

Ensure appropriate handling and protection of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
SQL and T-SQL for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting.
SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
Power BI, including datasets, data refresh, publishing, and access control.
Microsoft Excel and Power Query.
Data correction and troubleshooting within LIS and related systems.
Secure file transfers using SFTP and other file-based exchange methods.
Automation, monitoring, and recovery of scheduled data jobs.
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and ETL processes is an asset.
Scripting or programming using PowerShell, Python, C#/.NET, or similar technologies is an asset.




Qualifications:




Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or Health Informatics or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience.

Experience:

Proven experience supporting SQL Server data, reporting, and integration environments.
Strong SQL/T-SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, and data validation.
Experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and datasets.
Experience with data integrations, ETL processes, and file-based data transfers.
Experience working with sensitive or confidential data in a regulated environment.
Familiarity with PHIPA and the handling of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Experience using a Laboratory Information System (LIS) is an asset.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive operational environment.

Key Competencies:

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation and organizational skills.
Ability to work across data, reporting, integration, and enterprise systems.
Strong commitment to data security, privacy, and confidentiality.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Meaningful mission with real health sector impact.
Collaborative, supportive executive leadership.
Opportunities to make an immediate impact, optimize operations, and expand your expertise.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Position Summary

The successful candidate will possess strong experience working with Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, and large operational datasets, while demonstrating the ability to communicate meaningful business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze global contact centre performance across sales, service, customer experience, productivity, and operational KPIs.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, executive reporting, and performance reviews.
Support forecasting, incentive reporting, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key performance drivers across regions and teams.

Technical Development & Data Management

Develop and maintain SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions within Snowflake and Power BI.
Manage and integrate data from contact centre, CRM, workforce, and sales platforms.
Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.
Ensure data quality, KPI consistency, and reporting governance standards are maintained.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Present reporting outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Serve as a trusted resource for KPI definitions, reporting methodology, and operational analytics.

Process Improvement & Transformation

Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.
Support transformation initiatives, including CCaaS, AI, and reporting modernization programs.
Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.




About You

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Performance & Optimization
Description:
Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
Propose practical solutions to identified performance gaps, supported by an assessment of expected financial benefit, implementation effort, risks, and dependencies.
Implement improvements within the role’s scope, including revised analytical models, reporting processes, automated checks, decision-support tools, and operating review procedures.
Coordinate approved cross-functional improvements with the responsible teams, such as changes to pricing, operating practices, maintenance priorities, or software functionality.
Track actions through completion, measure results against the original baseline, and determine whether the underlying performance gap has been resolved.
Communicate findings and recommendations through clear dashboards, reports, and presentations that explain what changed, why it matters, what action is recommended, and whether the action worked.


Scope & Collaboration

This role owns the analytical process and the development of performance-monitoring workflows. It is also expected to drive approved improvements through implementation, rather than ending its involvement at the recommendation stage.

Finance retains responsibility for accounting policies and financial reporting approval. Network Operations and Engineering retain responsibility for operational interventions, equipment changes, and production-system releases. The analyst works with these teams to ensure that improvements are implemented appropriately and their impact is measured.

Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial/Financial Engineering, Engineering Science, Business Analytics, Computational Finance, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, operational analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joining multiple data sources, time-based analysis, aggregation, and investigating incomplete or inconsistent records.
Hands-on Python skills for data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and workflow automation, using libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
Demonstrated experience developing a repeatable analytical or reporting workflow, improving it through practical use, and automating it or transferring it to an ongoing owner.
Working knowledge of profit-and-loss analysis, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margins, and forecast-versus-actual variance analysis.
Experience building and evaluating forecasts or scenario models, with an understanding of seasonality, uncertainty, and forecast error.
Strong investigative skills, including the ability to test competing explanations for performance gaps and avoid treating correlation alone as proof of causation.
Experience contributing to the implementation of a business, analytical, or operational improvement and assessing its results.
Strong Excel skills and experience presenting findings through Power BI, Tableau, Python-based visualizations, or comparable tools.
Good documentation, version-control, and testing practices for analytical code and recurring workflows.
Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate cross-functional work, and follow through on unresolved issues.
Legal entitlement to work in Canada.


Preferred


Experience analysing EV charging, energy storage, electricity consumption, connected equipment, or multi-site infrastructure operations.
Familiarity with electricity tariffs, demand charges, energy losses, asset availability, or site-level operating economics.
Experience reconciling operational data with payment records, utility bills, or financial reporting systems.
Experience with time-series forecasting or machine learning, including model validation and comparison against simpler baseline methods. Familiarity with TensorFlow or similar frameworks is an asset.
Familiarity with AWS-based data environments, scheduled data-processing jobs, or integration with production reporting systems.
Experience supporting site investment assessments, deployment forecasts, or portfolio-level financial models.


What Success Looks Like

Success means Jule has a reliable, repeatable process for understanding and improving portfolio profitability. Reports require less manual preparation, material performance gaps are identified and explained sooner, forecasts become better grounded in operating evidence, and approved improvements produce measurable results.

Mature workflows are documented, automated where appropriate, and handed over with clear ownership—allowing this role to continue addressing new performance challenges rather than becoming permanently occupied with manual reporting.

What You Will Gain


Hands-on experience connecting EV charging and energy storage performance with site and portfolio economics.
Opportunities to develop practical skills in forecasting, financial analysis, workflow automation, and operational improvement.
Direct exposure to decisions across product, finance, software, and network operations.
Professional growth toward broader responsibilities in portfolio analytics, asset performance, or operational optimization.


Pay Transparency & Hiring Process

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

We are a fair, equitable, and inclusive employer committed to transparent and human-centered hiring practices. As part of this commitment, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen applications. Every résumé is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to help reduce bias and ensure candidates are assessed fairly and thoughtfully.

All candidates who participate in an interview will be informed of the hiring decision in accordance with applicable Ontario employment requirements.

The expected salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000 per year, with final compensation determined based on skills, qualifications, education, technical capabilities, and relevant experience. We are committed to pay equity and to offering compensation that is fair, transparent, and competitive.


Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Paid time off.
On-site parking.
Professional growth and development opportunities.


Jule is committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and AODA. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

How To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience. Highlight an example where you used programming to develop or automate a workflow, investigated a performance gap, and helped implement an improvement. Describe your personal contribution and the resulting outcome.

eCAMION is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities

Position Summary:

As a Business Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, leverage data driven insights and automation solutions to guide strategic business decisions, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical skills, with a focus on data automation and process optimization. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset and a strong problem-solving abilities, and can translate complex datasets into scalable, automated solutions and actionable business recommendations.

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

Data Automation, Analysis & Interpretation


Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple data sources (JDE, KOMPASS, MBSYNC, Samsara, Paragon, among others) and data warehouse (Snowflake) to enable automated insights into business performance
Design and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify patterns, trends, and relationships that inform business decisions
Assist in the design and deployment of analytics analysis to support process optimization and data insights
Perform root cause analysis of business challenges and recommend automated, data-driven solutions
Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost reductions, and efficiency gains using data and automation
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Reporting and Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain automated reports, dashboards, and visualizations
Collaborate with department heads to define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to the company’s strategic goals
Translate business questions into data requirements and provide concise answers through self-service reporting and automation


Alternative Solutions (Machine Learning and AI Integration)


Work with the global team to identify opportunities for alternative solutions
Assist and support in the deployment of models that support operational decision-making
Evaluate results and continuously improve automated solutions to align with business objectives
Stay updated on emerging technologies and integrate modern automation techniques into business workflows


Data Quality & Governance


Maintain data integrity, ensure consistency across automated processes. Collaborate with data ingestion and IT teams to close data gaps and improve automation readiness
Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with various business units (Operations & Transportation, Finance, Supply Chain, ROP, REX, Centralized Routing) to understand their business needs and develop tailored automation or reporting solutions. Present automated data insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Serve as a liaison between technical teams (data ingestion, engineering) and business stakeholders to align automation efforts with priorities


Project Management


Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects focused on
data automation, insight generation, and continuous improvement. Track project milestones and ensure timely delivery of automation initiatives
Other projects or duties as assigned


Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science or a related field. 2-4+ years of experience data automation and process optimization. Experience building Extract, Transform & Load (ETL) processes and managing data pipelines across multiple data sources and warehouses
Willingness to understand business operations and identify automation opportunities
Experience of scripting languages (like Python, R, SQL) and data process workflow automation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to explore alternative solutions that support data automation and process optimization insight delivery
Collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
This position must pass a post-offer background check


Preferred Skills And Experience


Master’s degree preferred

Title: Client Data Analyst II
Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Responsibilities


Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
Lead the standardized measurement strategy for clients and team leaders
Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
Use statistical analysis to understand the key drivers of the business and provide recommendations for optimization and go-to-market strategies
Compile data into professional reports that support both findings and recommendations quantitatively and qualitatively. Clearly articulate compelling business insights and actions with data and context
Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties’ research and implement best practices, with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
Other assigned duties



Qualifications


Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
3-5 years of related work experience
1-2 years of project management experience
Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up
Intermediate statistical analysis skills
Experience with SPSS, Python, R, or other stats software
Intermediate PowerBI, Tableau, or Looker skills; other data visualization platform skills a plus
Ability to tell a relevant, powerful story with data that matters to clients
Ability to lead research activities including developing a plan, collecting data, and taking action
Ability to execute standard measurement strategies within a project
Strong analytical and critical thinking with the ability to disseminate insight from large datasets
Develop understanding of all areas phases of Mosaic business to find new opportunities for insights, measurement, and analytics
Proven ability to timely complete projects and achieve results in an ambiguous work environment

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Job Title

Sr. Analyst, Loyalty Analytics

Canada Goose isn't like anything else. We've built something great, something special - an iconic lifestyle brand with an inspirational and authentic story. At the heart of it is our promise to inspire and enable all people to thrive in the world outside. To Live in the Open. At Canada Goose, you're part of a movement that belongs to something bigger. Position Overview

You will own the analytics function for loyalty, turning complex customer, transaction, and engagement data into strategic recommendations that boost retention, increase lifetime value, and maximize program ROI. This is a high-impact senior role where your expertise will directly shape loyalty strategy.

Development and optimization of advanced SQL queries and data models to extract, transform, and analyze large volumes of loyalty, transactional, subscription, and behavioral data from multiple sources.
Design, build, and maintain self-served Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced DAX, star-schema modeling, and performance optimization techniques to track key loyalty metrics such as retention/churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), segment performance, redemption rates, campaign ROI, and tier effectiveness.

Support end-to-end loyalty analytics: evaluate marketing campaigns effectiveness and provide clear, actionable recommendations to the loyalty and Marketing teams.
Partner closely with Product, Finance, and Executive teams to translate insights into prioritized business strategies and roadmaps.
Present compelling, executive-ready insights and storytelling dashboards/Presentations to senior leadership.


Let's Talk About You


Advanced SQL expertise – highly proficient with complex queries (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, and optimization) on large-scale datasets.
Expert-level Power BI proficiency is a must – strong command of DAX, data modeling, row-level security, custom visuals, and Power BI Service governance.
Previous experience with loyalty programs – proven track record analyzing loyalty initiatives (points, tiers, rewards, redemption, retention mechanics).
5+ years of hands-on analytics experience, preferably in loyalty, CRM, customer retention, or related domains.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to executive audiences.


What’s in it For You?


A company built on Canadian roots and heritage
Your work is recognized with a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards Program
Opportunities for career growth through numerous internal and external programs
Recognize and be recognized by your peers with our Goose Rewards & ICON Rewards
Be a part of CG Gives. Donation matching and paid volunteer time to help the organizations you care about
Access to tools and resources to support physical and mental health, embracing change and connecting with colleagues
Inspiring leaders and colleagues who will lift you up and help you grow

$73,000.00 - $102,000.00 / year

When we make an offer, we consider the responsibilities of the position, market data, and internal equity to ensure consistency across our team. Your actual offer will depend on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role.

Sr. Specialist, Business Intelligence Analyst

Reference #40969

Waterdown, Ontario

About L3HARRIS WESCAM

As a subsidiary of L3Harris Technologies and within the Integrated Mission Systems Segment, the WESCAM division develops the most advanced optical sensor and targeting systems for global defense and military sectors, National Security, Search & Rescue and Airborne law enforcement agencies. From long-range covert surveillance missions to search and rescue operations, our MX-series systems, and the mission systems solutions they are a part of, produce stabilized high-magnification electro-optical and infrared images from airborne, marine and ground based platforms, enabling our customers to see first and act first.

About The Role

As a Business Intelligence (BI) analyst, you will be an agent of change within the organization by being a major contributor to culture shift in relation to data. You will communicate with the senior leaders, managers, supervisors and functional experts of the various Canadian divisions to propose the implementation of strategic indicators on which they will base their decisions. You will participate in the discussion, planning and execution of key performance indicators and interactive dashboards.

Responsibilities:

You will work in close collaboration with several groups within the company (planning, production, operations, program management, engineering, supply chain, etc.) in a multi-site context. You will transform data into actionable insights and information for our internal customers by leveraging your business acumen. With your knowledge of business intelligence and your analytical skills, you will be able to assess the capabilities and possible applications of organizational data. You will offer coaching and support to internal BI contributors to develop their autonomy and raise their level of BI maturity. In short, you will be an ambassador of business intelligence in the organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Work with senior leadership and other business leaders to identify opportunities for improvement;
Create dashboards and data strategies for internal teams and / or external stakeholders;
Collaborate with team members to collect and analyze data;
Establish Key Performance Indicators to measure the effectiveness of business decisions;
Structure large data sets to find usable information;
Work with a team of analysts and other associates to process information;
Create presentations and reports based on recommendations and findings.



Required Capabilities


Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power BI
Proficiency in SQL and Power Query languages
Knowledge of data extraction, transformation and load (ETL) with SSIS and OLAP cubes
Ability to analyze and model business needs
Excellent communication skills in English (oral and written)
Ability to adapt in a dynamic environment and prioritize business requests
Agile to work simultaneously on one or more projects within a matrix organization
Familiarity with applying AI-driven analytics tools (e.g. predictive analytics in Microsoft Fabric) an asset
Experience preparing data and data models for AI ingestion an asset
Experience interfacing with customers and working in large enterprise, implementing complex solutions.
Experience in the aerospace and defense industry an asset



Desired Education And Experiences


Requires strong knowledge of job area.
Typically viewed as having a specialty within discipline.
May have broad knowledge of project management.
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience.
Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience.
In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
This posting is for a current vacancy. In the province of Ontario, Canada, the pay range for this position will be $90,000 to $140,000
