We build customized loyalty marketing and human experience solutions for our clients, enabled by technology and data insights. The Client Analytics team at Bond is responsible for the ‘last mile’ in analytics delivery. They use best-in-class analytical solutions to interpret the data and deliver insights that enable our clients to build stronger bonds with their customers. This team works directly with clients as well as internal account consultants to bring forward insight driven business recommendations.  
 

The Sr. Analyst will play a key role in supporting the development of customer-centric business and loyalty marketing strategies by identifying opportunities, leading analysis, reporting on performance, formulating recommendations, testing hypotheses, and communicating findings. The successful candidate will work closely with our consultants and will play a significant role in the use of insights to drive business outcomes. 





Job Requirements



Bachelor’s degree in an analytical discipline (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Math, or equivalent). Master’s Degree is a plus. 
3+ years of relevant work experience in an analytical discipline (business analysis, analytics, data science, business intelligence, statistics). 
Strong business acumen and demonstrated experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, and loyalty analytics. 
Strong communication skills: effective at communicating a compelling summary of findings and explaining analytical methodologies. 
High proficiency with database languages (SQL) and programming languages (Python, R). Experience with big-data languages. (PySpark) is a plus. 
High proficiency with data visualization in BI reporting tools (PowerBI, Tableau). 
Experience with advanced analytics techniques (supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical testing, simulation, optimization). 

High proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel. 





Job Responsibilities


Lead analytics projects from start to finish: develop hypotheses, gather requirements, conduct analyses, translate findings into insights and recommendations, create material to communicate insights (PowerPoint/BI reports), and present to client stakeholders. 
Write efficient Python and SQL code to conduct analyses on large, complex data sets. 
Design, build, and maintain analytics reports and dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau). 
Proactively conduct analyses to identify opportunities for business improvement. 
Dive headfirst into ambiguous client problems; use highly-structured thinking to develop logical approaches and solutions. 
Build effective communication material in PowerPoint/BI Tools/Excel and communicate analytical findings to both technical and non-technical client audiences. 
Learn about and implement advanced analytics methods in marketing, customer, and loyalty contexts (supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical testing, simulation, optimization).

Job Description

At Bond, we build growth and loyalty for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Behind that work is a team of smart, curious people who care deeply about clients, each other, and building something meaningful together.

We build customized loyalty marketing and human experience solutions for our clients, enabled by technology and data insights. The Client Analytics team at Bond is responsible for the ‘last mile’ in analytics delivery. They use best-in-class analytical solutions to interpret the data and deliver insights that enable our clients to build stronger bonds with their customers. This team works directly with clients as well as internal account consultants to bring forward insight driven business recommendations.  
 

The Sr. Analyst will play a key role in supporting the development of customer-centric business and loyalty marketing strategies by identifying opportunities, leading analysis, reporting on performance, formulating recommendations, testing hypotheses, and communicating findings. The successful candidate will work closely with our consultants and will play a significant role in the use of insights to drive business outcomes. 



Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in an analytical discipline (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Math, or equivalent). Master’s Degree is a plus. 
  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in an analytical discipline (business analysis, analytics, data science, business intelligence, statistics). 
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, and loyalty analytics. 
  • Strong communication skills: effective at communicating a compelling summary of findings and explaining analytical methodologies. 
  • High proficiency with database languages (SQL) and programming languages (Python, R). Experience with big-data languages. (PySpark) is a plus. 
  • High proficiency with data visualization in BI reporting tools (PowerBI, Tableau). 
  • Experience with advanced analytics techniques (supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical testing, simulation, optimization). 

  • High proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel. 



Job Responsibilities

  • Lead analytics projects from start to finish: develop hypotheses, gather requirements, conduct analyses, translate findings into insights and recommendations, create material to communicate insights (PowerPoint/BI reports), and present to client stakeholders. 
  • Write efficient Python and SQL code to conduct analyses on large, complex data sets. 
  • Design, build, and maintain analytics reports and dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau). 
  • Proactively conduct analyses to identify opportunities for business improvement. 
  • Dive headfirst into ambiguous client problems; use highly-structured thinking to develop logical approaches and solutions. 
  • Build effective communication material in PowerPoint/BI Tools/Excel and communicate analytical findings to both technical and non-technical client audiences. 
  • Learn about and implement advanced analytics methods in marketing, customer, and loyalty contexts (supervised learning, unsupervised learning, statistical testing, simulation, optimization). 

Benefits

Compensation: The expected base salary compensation for this role is $77,600.00 to $98,200.00 CAD annually. 
Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI): Bond uses AI tools during parts of the screening, assessment, and selection process, supporting a fair and efficient hiring process.   We welcome applications from all qualified candidates; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.  
Vacancy Type: This posting is for an existing vacancy.  
The actual base salary compensation will vary depending on local market conditions, geography, and relevant job-related factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training.  
 
At Bond, we believe compensation is more than a salary. Our Total Rewards program is designed to help you grow your career, support your well-being and keep you meaningfully connected:   Flexibility: A hybrid work model and flexible vacation offers agility to meet the needs of our global business and workforce, allowing us to inspire the best from our people. 
Moments that matter: Social events like F1rst Thursdays, Kick-Off gatherings, and holiday parties make it easy to build relationships and have fun. 
Health & Wellness support: Competitive healthcare and wellness benefits that care for both body and mind including Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Care Spending Account, Employee Assistance Program, access to 24/7 virtual healthcare and/or consultation services for you and your family - all available from your first day. 
Future-focused: Retirement planning assistance with company matching.  
Career development: Access to learning programs, mentorship, stretch projects, and internal mobility to keep you moving forward. 
Celebrating your impact: Recognition programs for individual and team achievements, peer-nominated awards, and service anniversaries.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Reference no. R2867765

Position title: Data Analyst

Department: Diamond

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Job

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

Reporting directly to the Sales and Demand Insights Data Product Manager, the Data Analyst (L2) is responsible for managing, analyzing, and transforming commercial data into AI-ready, trusted assets that power business decisions across US Brands.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement. The ideal candidate brings a strong command of data management and analytics, hands-on AI fluency, and a commitment to Sanofi's AI-Ready Data principles: Understood, Trusted, Safe, and Shared.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

AI-ENABLED ANALYTICS AND INSIGHT GENERATION


Leverage AI and machine learning tools and techniques, including generative AI and statistical models, to identify patterns, trends, and high-leverage insights from large commercial datasets
Develop and maintain AI-ready datasets, ensuring data is structured, governed, and fit-for-purpose for use in AI and ML solutions across US Brands
Apply Sanofi's Responsible AI (RAISE) framework principles when building or consuming AI-powered analytics, ensuring transparency, fairness, and ethical use
Explore opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities such as predictive demand modeling, sales forecasting, and segmentation into the Sales and Demand Insights product


DATA ANALYSIS AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE


Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that drive commercial decisions
Leverage data and facts to challenge conventional wisdom, form evidence-based conclusions, and identify high-leverage intervention points
Identify and analyze business needs that support the product strategy, harmonizing across business areas for a unified commercial data foundation for all US Brands
Communicate solution trade-offs clearly to frame and influence project decisions


DATA ENGINEERING AND AI-READY DATA DEVELOPMENT


Design and define ingestion processes to ensure efficient data flow and integration aligned with Sanofi's Data Mesh architecture
Build and maintain data pipelines that meet Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards: quality-scored, classified, governed, and discoverable in the Data Marketplace
Develop detailed functional specifications and test cases based on business requirements
Apply strong understanding of data warehousing concepts including design patterns and ETL and ELT load strategies


DATA QUALITY AND GOVERNANCE


Implement and monitor Data Quality rules in line with Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness
Ensure datasets are scored via Informatica CDGC and remediated when below defined quality thresholds
Support data classification, access policy definition, and privacy-by-design principles in compliance with Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, and cybersecurity requirements
Collaborate with Business Data Stewards and Digital roles to maintain shared data ownership and accountability


INNOVATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT


Proactively monitor industry, functional, and technology trends, particularly in AI and ML, generative AI, and commercial analytics
Identify new opportunities to leverage data and integrate internal and external sources to enhance business value
Aggregate and evaluate digital data sources including web, email, social media, and CRM to enrich commercial insights


About You

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, data manipulation, and data management
Expert proficiency in SQL and data querying
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and AI and ML workflows
Hands-on experience building or consuming AI-ready datasets and working with AI and ML platforms
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and ethical data use including bias, fairness, and transparency
Experience with data warehousing, Snowflake, ETL and ELT pipelines, and cloud platforms
Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-moving, agile environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in commercial pharmaceuticals, biotech, or healthcare
Familiarity with Sanofi's AI Foundry, Data Mesh, or Informatica CDGC
Knowledge of generative AI tools and large language model-based analytics applications
Experience with digital data sources including web analytics, CRM, email, social media, and TV
Knowledge of Six Sigma and Agile practices


Tools And Technologies


Snowflake, SQL, Python, Informatica, AWS
JIRA, Confluence
Microsoft Suite including Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint
Power BI or equivalent data visualization tools


Sanofi Skills Profile - Data Analysis L2

(Aligned to Sanofi Global Jobs and Skills Official Taxonomy 2025)

Technical Skills


Structured Query Language - SQL (Experienced)
Data Visualization (Intermediate)
Applied Statistics (Experienced)
Data Modeling (Experienced)


Functional Skills


Data Analytics (Intermediate)
Data Quality (Intermediate)
Data Management (Intermediate)
Responsible AI (Intermediate)


Transversal Skills


Business Acumen (Experienced)
Communication (Experienced)
Decision Making (Intermediate)
Professional Collaboration (Experienced)


Why Choose Us?


Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs.


This position is for a new vacant role that is now open for applications.

AI Usage 

"Artificial Intelligence” refers to any systems that use automated processes, including algorithms and machine learning, to analyze data and make predictions, inferences, decisions, or recommendations without direct human involvement. These systems may process personal information to identify patterns, improve services, or support decision-making. The Company may use Artificial Intelligence for purposes including, but not limited to, resume screening and hiring, scheduling interviews or meetings, conducting surveys, matching skills with potential job openings, interview scoring, ensuring compliance with regulations applicable to our industry, and activities related to performance evaluation. Information collected and processed by the Company’s Artificial Intelligence systems may include the personal information detailed above and calendar availability. It excludes the information collected and processed for monitoring purposes. You should contact Human Resources if you have a question or concern regarding your personal information. You can also contact Canada’s Privacy Officer via Sanofi’s data subject request portal,  Data Subject Rights Webform. The Data Subject Rights Webform can also be used to request access or correction of your personal information and file a complaint. 

Sanofi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Our goal is to attract, develop and retain highly talented employees from diverse backgrounds, allowing us to benefit from a wide variety of experiences and perspectives. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified applicants.  Accommodations for persons with disabilities required during the recruitment process are available upon request.

Title: Data & Analytics Analyst
Description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

The Data & Analytics Analyst enables data-driven decision-making across the organization by transforming complex data into meaningful insights and performance reporting. The role is responsible for designing and maintaining KPI dashboards and scorecards in Power BI, utilizing SAP SAC and Fiori to deliver detailed operational and business reporting. In addition, the position establishes strong data governance practices by documenting KPI definitions, business rules, ownership, and usage guidelines, ensuring alignment across functions and reducing inconsistencies in reporting. Through trusted analytics and standardized metrics, the role supports business leaders in making informed and timely decisions.

In this role, you will:

KPI Reporting & Dashboarding (Power BI)


Design, build, and maintain KPI dashboards/scorecards in Power BI to support performance management routines and faster decision-making.
Produce recurring KPI reporting packs (e.g., service/case fill, inventory health/DOS, forecast-related views) with clear commentary on trends and drivers.
Partner with stakeholders to translate KPI needs into usable visuals, filters, and drill paths that align to how teams manage the business.


Transactional & Detailed Reporting (SAC/Fiori)


Use SAC and Fiori to access SAP transactional and detailed reporting needed for root-cause analysis and operational deep dives.
Cross-check transactional views (SAC/Fiori) versus aggregated dashboards (Power BI) to improve confidence in KPI interpretation and decisions


Data Quality, Governance & Documentation


Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across reports; coordinate resolution with report owners/stewards and affected stakeholders.
Maintain and publish reporting documentation (definitions, intended use/purpose, sources, calculation logic, and ownership/stewardship), aligned to enterprise governance approaches.
Contribute to dashboard “link hygiene” and user guidance so that consumers can easily find the right source report and definitions for each KPI.


Problem Identification & Continuous Improvement


Identify performance risks/opportunities using variance, exceptions, and trend analysis; frame the “so what” and recommended actions for KPI owners.
Support continuous improvement by quantifying baseline, diagnosing drivers, and tracking impact through sustained KPI monitoring (e.g., case fill changes over time).


What we look for:

Years and Type of Experience:


2 - 3 years of experience in analytics and reporting, KPI performance management, and cross-functional problem-solving, preferably supporting supply chain, operations, or other business functions.
Experience working with operational/service and inventory metrics and producing recurring performance reporting packs.


Skills and Abilities:

Must-have


Hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting in Power BI (e.g., authoring in Desktop and publishing/sharing via the service).
Working knowledge of SAC and Fiori for SAP transactional and detailed reporting (or strong ability to learn quickly).
Strong analytical problem solving: ability to identify drivers, explain variance, and translate analysis into actions.
Documentation discipline: ability to write clear metric definitions, intended use, and calculation notes to improve shared understanding.
2+ years experience working in data or business analytics with a proven track record of validating AI assisted insights.
Handse-on exposure to modern BI or workspace tools featuring embedded o generative AI features (power BI copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise).


Nice-to-have


Familiarity with report governance/catalog practices (owners/stewards tracked centrally.
Continuous improvement methods (Lean/Six Sigma) applied to operations or supply chain analytics (optional, depending on your preference).
Exposure to Vista reporting change concepts and expectations (e.g., Fiori/SAC go-live and reporting evolution).


This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Workplace type:

Hybrid

Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive. Learn more.

[Canada] Additional Information:

At Clorox, we champion people to be well and thrive, starting with our own people. To help make this possible, we offer comprehensive, competitive benefits that prioritize all aspects of well-being and provide flexibility for our teammates’ unique needs. This includes robust health plans, a competitive pension program with a company match, paid time off benefits (including half-day summer Fridays, depending on location), Maternity leave benefits, and more.

We are committed to fair and equitable pay and are transparent with current and future teammates about our salary ranges. We use broad salary ranges that reflect the competitive market for similar jobs, provide sufficient opportunity for growth as you gain experience and expand responsibilities, while also allowing for differentiation based on performance. Your starting pay will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, knowledge, experience, and location. Below is the targeted range for this role.

Sales: $73,043 - $112,487

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Enercare Inc. is one of Canada’s largest home and commercial services companies servicing over one million customers across Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Quebec and New Brunswick. Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.

A proudly Canadian-owned company, we are the Experts at what we do and deeply care about our customers. We value a diverse, collaborative culture, and take pride in our commitment to health and safety, and knowing our work serves and supports our communities every day. No matter your role, we invest in making sure you have opportunities to grow, learn, and become the Expert you want to be.

If you are ready to become one of our Experts, we would love to hear from you.

Role: Business Analyst

Status: Regular, Full Time

Reports to: Senior Manager, Business Markets Strategy and Analytic

Department: Builder Division

Location: Markham

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Summary

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Business & Data Analyst to join our team. This role is ideal for someone early in their analytics career who is eager to learn and contribute to data-driven decision-making, reporting, and process improvement initiatives. You will support senior analysts and business stakeholders by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data to uncover insights and drive operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
Description:
Clarivate provides advisory and management consulting services to industry leading and emerging pharmaceutical, biotechnology and MedTech companies. We combine deep domain expertise and data driven analysis to deliver relevant insights and customized, actionable solutions for our clients in the areas of new product planning, commercial strategy and pricing & market access.

We are seeking a Healthcare Research & Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support high‑impact analytical and market insights projects by interpreting complex healthcare datasets, identifying key trends, and developing actionable recommendations for clients. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, engage directly with customers, and help deliver the trusted intelligence that enables our clients to accelerate innovation and improve patient outcomes.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in sciences, healthcare, data analytics, or business.
Minimum 3 years of experience in quantitative data analysis, ideally with exposure to healthcare datasets.
Proven experience working with complex datasets, investigate data issues, identify trends/gaps, and produce actionable insights.
Proficient in SQL, with experience querying and managing large, multi-dimensional data sources.
Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting data insights to internal and external stakeholders.


It would be great if you also have…


Advanced degree
Experience with life sciences customers
Familiarity with additional data languages (e.g., Python, R), which would help expand analytical capabilities and improve efficiency in working with complex healthcare datasets
Exposure to or experience with project management responsibilities, including planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams


What You Will Be Doing In This Role...


Lead end-to-end market research projects delivering quantitative insights on global medical device markets, while building market models using Clarivate’s proprietary healthcare datasets.
Develop deep expertise in healthcare data and the medical industry, building strong knowledge of backend datasets, data dictionaries, and product methodology to confidently interpret, explain, and apply insights.
Engage directly with clients—from Fortune 500 companies to startups—to understand their pain points, manage calls with high-level knowledge of their product portfolios, and provide strategic solutions that address their challenges.
Deliver impactful presentations and training, using concise PowerPoint summaries to clearly communicate findings, key trends, and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders.
Investigate complex data challenges by deep-diving into data pipelines and sample chain perspectives, proactively identifying issues, highlighting gaps/trends, and proposing actionable solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams, capturing client feedback, informing statement of work documentation, and contributing to product enhancements, features, and data model evolution.


Hours of Work


This is a full-time position, working primarily core business hours EST zone
This is a hybrid position working in the office up to 3 days a week within our offices centrally located in Toronto


The expected base salary for this position is $54,400 - $68,000 CAD per year. This role is eligible for sales incentive earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.




This role represents an existing vacancy. Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role exclusively by submitting their application via email to hr@bcuﬁnancial.com. Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Job Title: Manager, Data Analytics

Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling enterprise-wide data-driven decision-making by managing and advancing McKesson’s data assets. This position is responsible for identifying, capturing, analyzing, and organizing data to support strategic and operational objectives. The role ensures adherence to information governance standards and leverages advanced analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform key business decisions. Collaborating with governance teams, data stewards, and business stakeholders, this position drives improvements in data quality, accessibility, and usability while influencing best practices across the organization.

Manage and advance the data fabric to organize, integrate, and deliver enterprise data assets.

Recommend analytics opportunities and best practices, influencing enterprise adoption of advanced analytics.

Advanced capability in data modeling and database design for complex analytical systems.
Proficiency in data quality management programs, including accuracy, completeness, and timeliness checks.
Advanced capability in cloud data warehousing and performance optimization for large-scale analytics.
Proficiency in metadata management and lineage documentation for compliance and governance.
Ability to implement advanced data integration pipelines and monitor data flow reliability.
Competence in Business Function Knowledge, Customer & Business Driven, Problem Solving, Building Relationships, Adaptability, Digital Acumen, and Creativity.
Clear written and verbal communication tailored to both business and technical audiences.



Technical Expertise:


Advanced experience leveraging Databricks, Snowflake, and SQL to develop scalable analytical datasets, models, and reporting solutions.
Strong proficiency with Power BI to deliver executive-ready dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to frame problems, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
Experience supporting commercial, pricing, customer, product, or portfolio analytics with an understanding of how insights drive business performance and decision-making.
Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous environments, balancing technical execution with strategic business consultation to deliver measurable outcomes.

Participate in the production of dashboards used to monitor the performance of the Bank’s credit portfolios.
Participate in the analysis of performance indicators related to the Bank’s credit portfolio.
Produce analyses, interpret data, explain variances, and assess their implications on the Bank’s results.

Participate in the migration of various reports and publications to the new data model.


Qualifications


University degree in Data Science and Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Finance, or any other related field.
Minimum of 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in Data Science or Risk Management.

Strong knowledge of database querying and management using SQL, as well as specialized statistical tools such as SAS (Enterprise Guide), Power BI and Tableau.
Ability to influence stakeholders and innovate in the solutions proposed.
Ability to simplify and communicate complex ideas effectively.
Knowledge of the banking industry, Canadian credit products, and credit risk management tools.
Strong analytical mindset with a problem-solving orientation.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to work.
Bilingual* (English and French)
Professional working proficiency in French and English languages required as position involves frequent written and oral communication on complex matters with internal and external parties in both languages.

Analyzing and interpreting large datasets related to capital markets, portfolios, and financial transactions

Collaborating with Data Engineers to support data ingestion, ELT workflows & transformations
Monitoring and troubleshooting data pipelines by querying CloudWatch logs
Supporting data validation, reconciliation, and ensuring data accuracy and integrity
Generating reports, dashboards, and insights for business stakeholders

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business analysis skills with experience in Agile and/or Waterfall environments.
Proven expertise in requirements management, business process analysis, and data mapping.
Ability to bridge business and financial domain knowledge with technical and data solutions.
Knowledge of data modeling, database design, and data validation/testing practices.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences.
Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams in fast-paced, cloud-based environments.

Proficiency with the MSOffice suite, including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Teams, and Outlook.
Experience with data pipelines and ETL processes in cloud environments.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis or scripting.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
Understanding of data modeling and warehouse design.
Exposure to Agile or data product environments.
Advanced SQL expertise across:

AWS Glue (jobs, configurations)

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities

Position Summary:

As a Business Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, leverage data driven insights and automation solutions to guide strategic business decisions, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical skills, with a focus on data automation and process optimization. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset and a strong problem-solving abilities, and can translate complex datasets into scalable, automated solutions and actionable business recommendations.

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

Data Automation, Analysis & Interpretation


Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple data sources (JDE, KOMPASS, MBSYNC, Samsara, Paragon, among others) and data warehouse (Snowflake) to enable automated insights into business performance
Design and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify patterns, trends, and relationships that inform business decisions
Assist in the design and deployment of analytics analysis to support process optimization and data insights
Perform root cause analysis of business challenges and recommend automated, data-driven solutions
Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost reductions, and efficiency gains using data and automation
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Reporting and Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain automated reports, dashboards, and visualizations
Collaborate with department heads to define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to the company’s strategic goals
Translate business questions into data requirements and provide concise answers through self-service reporting and automation


Alternative Solutions (Machine Learning and AI Integration)


Work with the global team to identify opportunities for alternative solutions
Assist and support in the deployment of models that support operational decision-making
Evaluate results and continuously improve automated solutions to align with business objectives
Stay updated on emerging technologies and integrate modern automation techniques into business workflows


Data Quality & Governance


Maintain data integrity, ensure consistency across automated processes. Collaborate with data ingestion and IT teams to close data gaps and improve automation readiness
Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Performance & Optimization
Description:
Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
Propose practical solutions to identified performance gaps, supported by an assessment of expected financial benefit, implementation effort, risks, and dependencies.
Implement improvements within the role’s scope, including revised analytical models, reporting processes, automated checks, decision-support tools, and operating review procedures.
Coordinate approved cross-functional improvements with the responsible teams, such as changes to pricing, operating practices, maintenance priorities, or software functionality.
Track actions through completion, measure results against the original baseline, and determine whether the underlying performance gap has been resolved.
Communicate findings and recommendations through clear dashboards, reports, and presentations that explain what changed, why it matters, what action is recommended, and whether the action worked.


Scope & Collaboration

This role owns the analytical process and the development of performance-monitoring workflows. It is also expected to drive approved improvements through implementation, rather than ending its involvement at the recommendation stage.

Finance retains responsibility for accounting policies and financial reporting approval. Network Operations and Engineering retain responsibility for operational interventions, equipment changes, and production-system releases. The analyst works with these teams to ensure that improvements are implemented appropriately and their impact is measured.

Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial/Financial Engineering, Engineering Science, Business Analytics, Computational Finance, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, operational analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joining multiple data sources, time-based analysis, aggregation, and investigating incomplete or inconsistent records.
Hands-on Python skills for data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and workflow automation, using libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
Demonstrated experience developing a repeatable analytical or reporting workflow, improving it through practical use, and automating it or transferring it to an ongoing owner.
Working knowledge of profit-and-loss analysis, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margins, and forecast-versus-actual variance analysis.
Experience building and evaluating forecasts or scenario models, with an understanding of seasonality, uncertainty, and forecast error.
Strong investigative skills, including the ability to test competing explanations for performance gaps and avoid treating correlation alone as proof of causation.
Experience contributing to the implementation of a business, analytical, or operational improvement and assessing its results.
Strong Excel skills and experience presenting findings through Power BI, Tableau, Python-based visualizations, or comparable tools.
Good documentation, version-control, and testing practices for analytical code and recurring workflows.
Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate cross-functional work, and follow through on unresolved issues.
Legal entitlement to work in Canada.


Preferred


Experience analysing EV charging, energy storage, electricity consumption, connected equipment, or multi-site infrastructure operations.
Familiarity with electricity tariffs, demand charges, energy losses, asset availability, or site-level operating economics.
Experience reconciling operational data with payment records, utility bills, or financial reporting systems.
Experience with time-series forecasting or machine learning, including model validation and comparison against simpler baseline methods. Familiarity with TensorFlow or similar frameworks is an asset.
Familiarity with AWS-based data environments, scheduled data-processing jobs, or integration with production reporting systems.
Experience supporting site investment assessments, deployment forecasts, or portfolio-level financial models.


What Success Looks Like

Success means Jule has a reliable, repeatable process for understanding and improving portfolio profitability. Reports require less manual preparation, material performance gaps are identified and explained sooner, forecasts become better grounded in operating evidence, and approved improvements produce measurable results.

Mature workflows are documented, automated where appropriate, and handed over with clear ownership—allowing this role to continue addressing new performance challenges rather than becoming permanently occupied with manual reporting.

What You Will Gain


Hands-on experience connecting EV charging and energy storage performance with site and portfolio economics.
Opportunities to develop practical skills in forecasting, financial analysis, workflow automation, and operational improvement.
Direct exposure to decisions across product, finance, software, and network operations.
Professional growth toward broader responsibilities in portfolio analytics, asset performance, or operational optimization.


Pay Transparency & Hiring Process

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

We are a fair, equitable, and inclusive employer committed to transparent and human-centered hiring practices. As part of this commitment, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen applications. Every résumé is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to help reduce bias and ensure candidates are assessed fairly and thoughtfully.

All candidates who participate in an interview will be informed of the hiring decision in accordance with applicable Ontario employment requirements.

The expected salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000 per year, with final compensation determined based on skills, qualifications, education, technical capabilities, and relevant experience. We are committed to pay equity and to offering compensation that is fair, transparent, and competitive.


Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Paid time off.
On-site parking.
Professional growth and development opportunities.


Jule is committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and AODA. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

How To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience. Highlight an example where you used programming to develop or automate a workflow, investigated a performance gap, and helped implement an improvement. Describe your personal contribution and the resulting outcome.

eCAMION is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Position Summary...The Manager, Data Analyst supports the Canadian Technology Data Engineering team by delivering hands on analytics, reporting, and insights for priority initiatives. This role focuses on translating defined business needs into high quality analysis, dashboards, and repeatable datasets—while partnering closely with Data Engineering to ensure reliable data sourcing, quality, and security practices. (No direct people management.)

What You'll Do...

Hands-on analytics delivery


Translate business questions into analytic requirements, data pulls, and repeatable reporting outputs.
Perform exploratory analysis and produce clear, decision‑ready insights; present findings in business language.


Data sourcing and integration


Identify and evaluate data sources; support processes to acquire, join, and validate data from multiple sources.
Partner with Data Engineering to improve dataset usability, documentation, and accessibility for analytics consumption.
Collaborate with other teams to aid with building visuals that directly support business decisions and ongoing operational tracking.


Data quality and controls


Monitor data quality indicators; proactively identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate fixes with engineering partners.
Coordinate and support security measures to safeguard information.


Initiative execution


Support multiple initiatives by tracking deliverables, documenting assumptions/definitions, and ensuring outputs are reproducible.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics/data work.
Strong experience in Retail (Brick & Mortar and eCommerce) and as a Data Analyst (7+ years)
Strong SQL experience and proficiency with at least one analytics/programming tool (e.g., Python/R).
Demonstrated ability to assess data quality, validate sources, and communicate limitations/assumptions.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with GCP/BigQuery and/or cloud data ecosystems.
Familiarity with statistical techniques (hypothesis testing, inference) and experiment measurement.
Experience with Generative and Agentic AI


Core Competencies


Strong execution, attention to detail, and documentation
Practical problem solving and data validation discipline
Clear communication and stakeholder responsiveness
Builds reusable assets; continuous improvement mindset


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

Company: Shoppers Drug Mart Specialty Health Network
Description:
Location:

1685 Tech Ave, Mississauga, Ontario, L4W 0A7

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Nature And Scope

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence and Insights is an individual with strong technical skills that will leverage SHN program, patient, and system data to generate outputs and insights that guide effective business decision making. They will work with key stakeholders within the BII team and within the program management and operations teams to understand requirements and develop data-driven solutions.

What You Will Do


Act as a conduit between client partners, SHN program management and operations teams, and the BII team to effectively understand and translate business and/or operational requirements into data-driven solutions and outputs.
Recommend and facilitate the development of specific data solutions, both as ad-hoc requests/support and for ongoing scheduled outputs
Adhere to best practices for testing and deploying aligned-on solutions
Validate outputs, analyze trends, identify opportunities and weaknesses for end users
Maintain business requirements, functional requirements and technical specification documentation for all outputs to ensure easy usability, referencing, and knowledge transfer
Assess impact to existing solutions/outputs due to proposed operational and system process changes


What You Will Need


Minimum 2-3 years of experience preferably in a pharmaceutical or healthcare industry
Post-Secondary education equivalent to a university degree in a numerate or analytical discipline such as Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.
Strong knowledge and understanding of relational databases and querying ability using SQL is a key skill
Familiarity with CRM platforms (eg. SalesForce) is a strong asset
Experience with Business Intelligence Platforms (eg. PowerBI) is a strong asset
Effective organizational and communication skills
Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills
Must be able manage time effectively through flexibility & prioritization in an environment of fast-paced change and ambiguity


Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy.

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

Employment Type

Full time

Type Of Role

Regular

We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the products we sell, the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities in the recruitment and assessment process and when hired.

Capital One is more than you think. We're a data-driven tech company that just happens to do credit cards. We focus on customer-first solutions, and we're united with this common goal. As a Data Analytics Associate, you will work with cross-functional teams to develop tools and data structures. As a creative problem-solver, you will be challenged to consider multiple options and select the optimal solution to meet the needs of your customers. You will own the recommendation and resolution to an existing business problem and will be involved end to end, from problem identification to solution deployment.

Transform raw data into data structures in our data lake and Snowflake data warehouse that are leveraged for business decision making.
Create, enhance and maintain critical data pipelines and processes.
Act as a steward for our data: ensuring it is high quality, trustworthy, well documented, and easy to use.
Build, automate, and maintain critical business reporting and visualizations that helps deliver insights.
Perform investigative analysis leveraging large/diverse datasets.

Will have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher in 2027.

Familiarity with SQL and/or data transformation tools such as dbt.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience

Advanced SQL expertise – highly proficient with complex queries (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, and optimization) on large-scale datasets.
Expert-level Power BI proficiency is a must – strong command of DAX, data modeling, row-level security, custom visuals, and Power BI Service governance.
Previous experience with loyalty programs – proven track record analyzing loyalty initiatives (points, tiers, rewards, redemption, retention mechanics).
5+ years of hands-on analytics experience, preferably in loyalty, CRM, customer retention, or related domains.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to executive audiences.

A company built on Canadian roots and heritage

Title: Client Data Analyst II
Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Responsibilities


Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
Lead the standardized measurement strategy for clients and team leaders
Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
Use statistical analysis to understand the key drivers of the business and provide recommendations for optimization and go-to-market strategies
Compile data into professional reports that support both findings and recommendations quantitatively and qualitatively. Clearly articulate compelling business insights and actions with data and context
Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties’ research and implement best practices, with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
Other assigned duties



Qualifications


Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
3-5 years of related work experience
1-2 years of project management experience
Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up
Intermediate statistical analysis skills
Experience with SPSS, Python, R, or other stats software
Intermediate PowerBI, Tableau, or Looker skills; other data visualization platform skills a plus
Ability to tell a relevant, powerful story with data that matters to clients
Ability to lead research activities including developing a plan, collecting data, and taking action
Ability to execute standard measurement strategies within a project
Strong analytical and critical thinking with the ability to disseminate insight from large datasets
Develop understanding of all areas phases of Mosaic business to find new opportunities for insights, measurement, and analytics
Proven ability to timely complete projects and achieve results in an ambiguous work environment

Founded in Montreal in 1846, Laurentian Bank is committed to serving its customers and fostering deep relationships with specialized groups. This role sits within Laurentian Bank.

Responsibilities


Participate in the production of dashboards used to monitor the performance of the Bank’s credit portfolios.
Participate in the analysis of performance indicators related to the Bank’s credit portfolio.
Produce analyses, interpret data, explain variances, and assess their implications on the Bank’s results.
Participate in data quality analysis in collaboration with governance teams.
Participate in the migration of various reports and publications to the new data model.


Qualifications


University degree in Data Science and Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Finance, or any other related field.
Minimum of 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in Data Science or Risk Management.


Specific Skills


Strong knowledge of database querying and management using SQL, as well as specialized statistical tools such as SAS (Enterprise Guide), Power BI and Tableau.
Ability to influence stakeholders and innovate in the solutions proposed.
Ability to simplify and communicate complex ideas effectively.
Knowledge of the banking industry, Canadian credit products, and credit risk management tools.
Strong analytical mindset with a problem-solving orientation.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to work.
Bilingual* (English and French)
Professional working proficiency in French and English languages required as position involves frequent written and oral communication on complex matters with internal and external parties in both languages.

Total compensation: Earn a comprehensive compensation package that includes annual reviews and performance-based bonuses.
